Title: Technical Data Package Analyst
Description:
Location: Halifax - Wilkinson, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Technical Data Package Analyst

Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements


This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level



Key Areas of Responsibility


Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems.
Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests.
Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data.
Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments.
Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records.
Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements.



Chorus Role


Prepare and Deliver Customer Service



Minimum Qualifications


Technical System Expertise: Proven experience using both Maximo and DRMIS (or CGCS/CGCM) is mandatory.
Software Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills are essential (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, and complex data reconciliation).
Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA.
Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment.
Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently.



If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Preferred Qualifications


Data Analytics & Database Tools: Proficiency in Power BI and Microsoft Access is considered a strong asset.
Defense & In-Service Support Experience: Experience with DND In-Service Support (ISS) contracts and experience supporting an operational military asset.
Logistics Support Analysis Expertise: Familiarity with Logistics Support Analysis (LSA) and exposure to Logistics Support Analysis application software such as OmegaPS.
Technical Publications & Documentation Standards: Knowledge of Canadian Forces Technical Orders (CFTOs) and government-adopted technical publications.
Digital Technical Data Standards: Knowledge of the S1000D specification and Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) format.
Language Requirements: Bilingualism (English/French).



Special Position Requirements


Schedule: Core business hours Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week.
Physical Environment: Hybrid position – which is a mix of working from home and onsite (in office, at customer site or on-board ships alongside in harbour.
Physical Demands: Predominantly office work but may be required to work in dockyards and onboard Naval ships.
Travel: Occasional domestic travel maybe required in support of the ships.



What We Offer

The reference Total Target Compensation (TTC) market range for this position, inclusive of annual base salary and the variable compensation target, is between Total Target Cash (TTC) $74,146.88– $126,733.63 CAD Annual. This reflects how companies in a similar industry and geographic region generally pay for similar jobs. This range helps the Company make pay decisions as one data point among many. Where a position falls within this range is also dependent on other factors including – but not limited to – the employee’s career path history, competencies, skills and performance, as well as the company’s annual salary budget, the customer’s program requirements, and the company’s internal equity. Thales may offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s status protected by local, state, or federal law.

AI

We use artificial intelligence–enabled tools as part of our recruitment process to support activities such as candidate discovery, résumé matching, and interview scheduling. These tools may help screen and assess applications and recommend potential matches based on the requirements within the job description. All hiring decisions, including candidate evaluation, selection, and disposition, are made by human recruiters. Artificial intelligence does not make hiring decisions on our behalf.

Why Join Us?

Say HI and learn more about working at Thales click here.

Thales provides an extensive benefits program for all full-time employees working 24 or more hours per week and their eligible dependents, including the following:


Company paid Extended Health, Dental, HSA, Life, AD&D, Short-term Disability, Cancer Care Program, travel insurance, Employee Assistance Plan and Well-Being program.
Retirement Savings Plans (RRSP, DCPP, TFSA) with a company contribution and a match to a DCPP, with no vesting period.
Company paid holidays, vacation days, and paid sick leave.
Voluntary Life, AD&D, Critical Illness, Long-Term Disability.
Employee Discounts on home, auto, and gym membership.



Thales is an equal opportunity employer which values diversity and inclusivity in the workplace. Thales is committed to providing accommodations in all parts of the interview process. Applicants selected for an interview who require accommodation are asked to advise accordingly upon the invitation for an interview. We will work with you to meet your needs. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.

Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.

Description

Apply today to join our True Blue Team in Edmonton or Calgary AB today!

Build foundational knowledge across the analytics stack, including Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Paginated Reports, Databricks, and Sigma

Collaborate regularly with internal stakeholders, including the Construction Services Sustainment Team, business leaders, operational teams, finance teams, project teams, Information Services, Data Engineering, and Data Governance teams to gather requirements, support reporting and analytics initiatives, and drive effective business outcomes
Communicate progress, blockers, risks, and questions clearly with team members and business partners
Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and a continuous learning mindset by asking thoughtful questions, seeking feedback, and building both technical and business knowledge
Perform other duties as assigned


Qualifications:


Minimum of a College, trade, or technical diploma or a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required
Minimum 3-5 years of experience developing business intelligence, analytics, reporting, or data visualization solutions
Experience gathering business requirements, translating them into technical solutions, and delivering reporting and analytics outcomes
Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modelling, report design, and SQL
Experience working with large and complex datasets to generate actionable business insights and support decision-making
Foundational knowledge of cloud-based analytics platforms and modern data ecosystems, including Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, or similar technologies
Understanding of data management principles, including data movement, modelling, quality, governance, and security
Experience working in Agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, and sprint-based delivery methodologies
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders while managing multiple priorities

Join Our Team

"Cascade Aerospace is one of Canada's leading specialty aerospace and defence contractors - a place where we do cool things for great customers!" We invite you to consider a career with us - come, experience our creative, innovative, and performance-based company!

Job Description

Financial Data Analyst supports financial planning, reporting, costing, and business decision-making through advanced data analysis and financial modeling. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Excel, Power BI, and database querying tools, combined with a solid foundation in accounting and ERP systems. This role will transform complex financial data into actionable insights that drive operational and financial performance.

CPA designation is not required. Candidates with strong analytical, financial modeling, and business intelligence skills are encouraged to apply.

This position requires immediate Controlled Goods clearance, therefore, only Canadian Citizens or Permanent Residents will be considered at this time.

Major Responsibilities & Duties

Financial Analysis & Reporting


Analyze large volumes of financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Develop and maintain recurring financial reports, dashboards, and KPIs.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes.
Provide actionable recommendations to management based on financial and business performance.


Financial Modeling


Build, maintain, and enhance financial models for budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.
Develop profitability, pricing, and cost allocation models.
Perform sensitivity and trend analyses to support business initiatives and investments.


Business Intelligence & Data Analytics


Design and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI.
Extract, transform, and analyze data using SQL, Power Query, and other query tools.
Improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and automation across finance processes.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to define reporting requirements and data solutions.


Costing & ERP Systems


Support product costing, operational costing, and margin analysis initiatives.
Analyze manufacturing, distribution, or operational costs to identify efficiency opportunities.
Maintain and validate financial data within ERP systems.
Partner with operations, supply chain, and accounting teams to improve cost visibility and reporting.


Accounting & Financial Controls


Apply general accounting principles to ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting.
Support month-end and year-end financial reporting activities.
Assist with account reconciliations, financial audits, and internal controls as required.
Ensure data integrity between ERP systems and reporting platforms.


Core Skills


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including: PivotTables, Power Query, Advanced formulas and functions, and Financial modeling
Strong proficiency in Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience writing and optimizing SQL queries and working with relational databases.
Strong understanding of data management, reporting automation, and analytics best practices.
Familiarity with ERP reporting tools and financial data structures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to translate complex financial data into clear business insights.
Effective communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Education


University degree in Business, Accounting or equivalent
CPA designation is not required.


Experience


3–7 years of experience in financial analysis, business analysis, data analytics, or related finance roles.
Experience building robust financial models and conducting financial analysis.
Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, JD Edwards, or similar).
Experience with costing and general accounting practices.
Experience in manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, or operational finance environments.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and business intelligence tools.
Experience with advanced analytics, forecasting, and scenario planning.
Understanding of cost accounting methodologies and profitability analysis.


Reasons To Apply


Employee retention and engagement is important to Cascade; we value our employees.
Comprehensive benefits package provided. Extended benefits and the Employee Resilience Program (all 100% paid by Cascade) are offered after 3 months of employment and Pension matching after 6 months.
ATO (Approved Training Organization) provides endorsement (type) training & development.
Company-wide social events and family functions throughout the year.
Relocation Package available for qualifying candidates.

Value Partners Investments (“VPI”) is a Winnipeg-based investment firm that currently manages approximately $7 billion through retail mutual funds (Value Partners Pools - “Pools”), which are distributed through investment dealers and mutual fund dealers across Canada, as well as through an investment counsel service (Value Partners Investment Counsel - “VPIC”) that provides discretionary wealth management services. Value Partners is currently registered as an investment fund manager, portfolio manager and exempt market dealer.

In March 2026, the VPI team officially joined the Canada Life company. Partnering with Canada Life strengthens our shared purpose of improving the financial well‑being of Canadians. By bringing together more than 4,000 trusted advisor relationships and $89 billion in assets under administration, Canada Life and Value Partners can expand access to advice and help more clients achieve greater financial security and confidence.

Canada Life is seeking an Intermediate Data Analyst to join the Value Partners team. In this role, you will transform data into actionable insights that support business decision-making and operational effectiveness. Through analytics, reporting, and visualization, you will help business stakeholders better understand performance, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to collaborate with business partners, technical teams, and data experts while supporting a growing data-driven culture. Success in this role requires strong analytical capabilities, expertise in business intelligence tools, and the ability to translate complex data into meaningful insights for a variety of audiences.

As part of your onboarding and ongoing development, you will gain an understanding of Value Partners' organizational structure, advisor and client relationships, products and services, and the broader financial services industry. You will contribute to solutions that support business priorities, strategic objectives, and organizational success.

What You Will Do


Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into meaningful analytics, visualizations, and reporting solutions
Act as a key liaison between business and technical teams, translating complex requirements into effective reporting and analytics solutions
Develop, enhance, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI
Analyze data to identify trends, uncover insights, and support informed business decisions
Lead the definition, documentation, and maintenance of key business metrics used across the organization
Collaborate with technical partners, including data architecture teams, to design and develop data models that support reporting and business requirements
Support the full reporting lifecycle, including requirements gathering, development, testing, validation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data presented in reports and dashboards
Write and maintain queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources
Train and support users on the effective use and adoption of reporting and visualization tools, including Power BI
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences
Develop a strong understanding of Value Partners' business model, products, advisor relationships, and service offerings to effectively support reporting and analytics needs
Contribute to the organization's business intelligence strategy and initiatives leveraging Microsoft Fabric
Support organizational objectives by aligning reporting solutions with business priorities, strategic initiatives, and company values
Continuously identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, data accessibility, and user experience


What You Will Bring


Diploma or degree in Business, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
2–3 years of experience working with business intelligence and data visualization tools, including strong expertise in Microsoft Power BI
Experience developing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations for business audiences
Strong knowledge of Power BI, including DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) and Power Query (M)
Hands-on experience working with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI and Tableau
Experience querying and analyzing data using SQL
Experience with Microsoft Fabric or related Microsoft data and analytics technologies is considered an asset
Experience with programming languages such as Python or R is considered an asset
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends and generate actionable insights
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to communicate complex information to diverse audiences
High attention to detail and a commitment to data quality and accuracy
Strong organizational, time management, and adaptability skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification is considered an asset


The base salary for this position is between $65,800 - $109,700 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
Description:
The Continuous Improvement Specialist bridges the gap between operational data and real-world execution. This role is responsible for analyzing courier, customer, and partner performance data to uncover hidden inefficiencies, designing structured "test and learn" pilots, and validating proof-of-concepts before they are scaled across global markets. The ideal candidate thrives on turning complex data into actionable recommendations and running live experiments in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Ultimately, this role is critical to optimizing our global logistics footprint, directly impacting courier satisfaction, cost efficiency, and customer loyalty.

Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis & Opportunity Identification
Analyze operational performance data and key performance indicators (including courier utilization, complaints, and delivery reliability) to identify trends, bottlenecks, and service risks.
Quantify and articulate specific areas of opportunity across courier experience and support touchpoints.
Partner with data teams to enhance dashboards and reports (utilizing tools like Tableau or SQL) to back all improvement initiatives with hard data.
Lead process improvement initiatives focused on service quality, operational efficiency, capacity utilization, and cost reduction.
Facilitate process mapping, root cause analysis, Kaizen events, and problem-solving workshops.
Pilot Execution & Experimentation
Develop and deliver continuous improvement initiatives across all courier experience and courier support touchpoints, ensuring cohesive plans, ongoing measurement and impact to couriers and team members
Adopt a strict "test and learn" culture by designing, launching, and managing live pilots to continuously experiment with operational hypotheses.
Drive a globalised and aligned approach while adapting for local needs
Establish clear success metrics for pilots to quickly determine feasibility for scaling across various markets.
Monitor, validate, and report on the realized benefits, cost-effectiveness, and productivity impacts of all implemented pilot programs.
Stakeholder Engagement & Scaling
Collaborate closely with operations leaders, market teams, and global functions to ensure pilots align with business priorities and local regulations.
Clearly present data-driven insights, pilot proposals, and project milestones to key stakeholders and management.
Develop current and future-state process documentation to ensure a seamless handoff to Operations, Training and QA teams when a pilot is approved for scaling.

Qualifications & Competencies


Experience: 3–4 years of experience in continuous improvement, business analysis, operations management, or logistics.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
Technical Skills: Strong analytical thinking with a data-driven approach ; experience using Tableau, SQL, or other data analytics tools is highly preferred.
Methodologies: Practical experience with Lean principles, root cause analysis, and project management practices.
Soft Skills: Exceptional stakeholder management skills ; independent thinker who is proactive and highly comfortable navigating ambiguity.


Why work at Skip?

Skip is the kind of workplace that garnered a “Top Places to Work in Manitoba” and it was no small coincidence. We set out to make this a place our employees are proud to tell their Mothers, Fathers, friends and anyone who will listen that they work here. Skip team members feel pride knowing their input and uniqueness are not only embraced but make an impact on a major Canadian company and its satisfied customers. As the company grows, so do you — you meet and surpass new challenges every day. That’s just a small taste of what it’s like to work at one of Canada’s leading tech companies. If you’re hungry for opportunity, growth, and something meaningful in a dynamic, fun and challenging environment, we’d love to hear from you.

SKIP is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where all employees feel they truly belong and where everyone is included, seen, heard and respected.

In keeping with our values, all applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of: gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, marital/domestic partner status, (dis)ability, neurodivergence, or any other characteristic protected by law. Should you require any accommodations throughout the hiring process, we encourage you to reach out to your talent acquisition specialist.

Note


All employees will be asked to sign a Consent for Disclosure of Personal Information in order to complete a background check. Job offers will be conditional upon results that the Company determines to be satisfactory.
This is a hybrid role, requiring 3 days per week in our Winnipeg office and 2 days per week working remotely from home.

Title: Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst
Description:
Location: Halifax - Wilkinson, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst

Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements


This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level



Key Areas of Responsibility


Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems.
Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests.
Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data.
Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments.
Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records.
Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements.



Chorus Role


Prepare and Deliver Customer Service



Minimum Qualifications


Technical System Expertise: Proven experience using both Maximo and DRMIS (or CGCS/CGCM) is mandatory.
Software Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills are essential (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, and complex data reconciliation).
Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA.
Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment.
Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently.



If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Preferred Qualifications


Data Analytics & Database Tools: Proficiency in Power BI and Microsoft Access is considered a strong asset.
Defense & In-Service Support Experience: Experience with DND In-Service Support (ISS) contracts and experience supporting an operational military asset.
Logistics Support Analysis Expertise: Familiarity with Logistics Support Analysis (LSA) and exposure to Logistics Support Analysis application software such as OmegaPS.
Technical Publications & Documentation Standards: Knowledge of Canadian Forces Technical Orders (CFTOs) and government-adopted technical publications.
Digital Technical Data Standards: Knowledge of the S1000D specification and Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) format.
Language Requirements: Bilingualism (English/French).



Special Position Requirements


Schedule: Core business hours Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week.
Physical Environment: Hybrid position – which is a mix of working from home and onsite (in office, at customer site or on-board ships alongside in harbour.
Physical Demands: Predominantly office work but may be required to work in dockyards and onboard Naval ships.
Travel: Occasional domestic travel maybe required in support of the ships.



What We Offer

The reference Total Target Compensation (TTC) market range for this position, inclusive of annual base salary and the variable compensation target, is between Total Target Cash (TTC) $74,146.88– $126,733.63 CAD Annual. This reflects how companies in a similar industry and geographic region generally pay for similar jobs. This range helps the Company make pay decisions as one data point among many. Where a position falls within this range is also dependent on other factors including – but not limited to – the employee’s career path history, competencies, skills and performance, as well as the company’s annual salary budget, the customer’s program requirements, and the company’s internal equity. Thales may offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s status protected by local, state, or federal law.

AI

We use artificial intelligence–enabled tools as part of our recruitment process to support activities such as candidate discovery, résumé matching, and interview scheduling. These tools may help screen and assess applications and recommend potential matches based on the requirements within the job description. All hiring decisions, including candidate evaluation, selection, and disposition, are made by human recruiters. Artificial intelligence does not make hiring decisions on our behalf.

Why Join Us?

Thales provides an extensive benefits program for all full-time employees working 24 or more hours per week and their eligible dependents, including the following:


Company paid Extended Health, Dental, HSA, Life, AD&D, Short-term Disability, Cancer Care Program, travel insurance, Employee Assistance Plan and Well-Being program.
Retirement Savings Plans (RRSP, DCPP, TFSA) with a company contribution and a match to a DCPP, with no vesting period.
Company paid holidays, vacation days, and paid sick leave.
Voluntary Life, AD&D, Critical Illness, Long-Term Disability.
Employee Discounts on home, auto, and gym membership.

Description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

Job Description

The team:

We are a unified, collaborative marketing team focused on creating meaningful client connections that drive business growth. We combine deep insights with strong partnerships to deliver timely, relevant, and impactful experiences for our clients. Our team is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. We align closely with distribution partners to generate demand and unlock new opportunities across the business. Above all, we measure and optimize our efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value, drive engagement, and strengthen loyalty to Invesco.

The role:

The Content Enablement Content Analyst is a key role within Invesco’s Global Content Enablement team, supporting the Americas & EMEA Marketing organization. This position executes the content strategy and roadmap to enhance the quality, accessibility, and usability of content across the EMEA region. The role focuses on building and managing content infrastructure, ensuring accurate categorization, distribution, and access across platforms and audiences. It partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver consistent, well-governed content solutions and ensure requirements are clearly defined and tested. This hands-on role is critical to improving content quality and driving engagement, ultimately enabling a stronger client and investment experience.

Responsibilities of the role:

Provides analytics support primarily for EMEA content domains, with additional support for North America.
Partners closely with EMEA Content Product Owners to deliver analysis across development, deployment, and research initiatives.
Defines and standardizes content quality metrics, building reporting and dashboards to provide visibility into content performance for senior leadership.
Collaborates with EMEA and NA domain experts to develop and maintain global taxonomy, aligning stakeholders to standardized definitions and fields.
Bridges business and technology teams to ensure solutions meet requirements and align with strategic priorities.
Maps business processes, develops expertise in content sources, and provides recommendations to improve content effectiveness.
Translates stakeholder needs into user stories and supports execution of content initiatives, including testing, impact analysis, and cross-team coordination.
Leads governance and documentation efforts, including content quality monitoring, process improvement, issue escalation, and maintaining records in tools such as Jira and Confluence.


Requirements of the role:

Bachelor’s degree, 5+ years in technology platforms, project management, or content development and distribution.
Experience with CMS and/or DAM platforms, content lifecycle management, and content migrations, including API-based integrations.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content analysis and UX or digital marketing concepts.
Strong skills in workflow/process mapping, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
Advanced technical proficiency, including SQL and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables; VBA a plus), along with strong desktop tool capabilities.
Strong analytical and statistical reasoning skills, with ability to organize, analyze, and communicate large data sets with accuracy and attention to detail.
Knowledge of content categorization (campaign, program, asset class, product), with preferred experience in investment or asset management content.
Client-focused, execution-oriented professional with strong communication, organizational, relationship-building, and influencing skills, plus a data-driven approach to measuring content performance and impact.

Title: Decision Support Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 46744

Organization

Vancouver is consistently ranked as one of the world’s most liveable and environmentally sustainable cities. Recognized among BC’s Top Employers and Canada’s Greenest Employers, the City of Vancouver is seeking colleagues who can help advance our core commitments to exceptional public service, sustainability, equity, and an outstanding quality of life for all residents.

With a strong commitment to being a City of Reconciliation, we invite you to join our dedicated team and become part of an innovative, inclusive, and engaging workplace. A career with the City of Vancouver and within the broader public service, offers meaningful work where you play a key role in ensuring equitable access to services, upholding ethical governance, and supporting the needs of citizens with integrity and dedication.

Main Purpose and Function

The Decision Support Analyst is part of the City’s Centre of Expertise for Performance Measurement and Decision Support, within the Strategy and Project Support Office (SPSO). The role supports evidence-informed decision-making across the City by helping leaders understand service performance, assess options, evaluate outcomes, and identify opportunities to improve accountability, transparency and value for money.

The role combines performance measurement, service evaluation, business analysis and business intelligence to help leaders make sound strategic, operational and service-delivery decisions. A core part of the team’s mandate is enabling the delivery of an enterprise-wide corporate planning process and the evaluation of City services, ensuring decisions are grounded in consistent, comparable evidence.

The analysis considers operational, financial, resource and service-delivery implications and supports recommendations to managers and senior leaders.

The Decision Support Analyst partners closely with corporate and departmental teams to build a culture of data-informed decision-making across the City. This includes increasing data literacy, enabling data exploration, supporting adoption of business intelligence tools, and translating complex analysis into clear, decision-ready insight.

Specific Duties/Responsibilities


Performance Measurement and Corporate Planning
Supports performance measurement reporting by linking City services and service plans to performance metrics, departmental work plans and the corporate plan.
Supports the design and delivery of the City’s enterprise-wide corporate planning process, helping connect service plans, performance measures and corporate priorities.
Supports corporate, capital and service-planning processes by connecting service plans and performance information to operating requirements, costs and resource implications.
Develops, monitors and analyzes performance metrics and benchmarks to assess the efficiency, effectiveness and outcomes of City services.
Helps identify short-term and long-term measures that support continuous improvement, service planning and corporate accountability.
Reviews and analyzes how major City decisions may affect service plans, performance measures and service-delivery outcomes.


Service Evaluation and Decision Support


Contributes to the evaluation of City services by helping define evaluation questions, identify measures of success, gather evidence, analyze outcomes and summarize findings.
Synthesizes quantitative and qualitative evidence into clear findings, implications and options for decision-makers.
Provides analytical decision support, including business analysis, options analysis, scenario modelling and business case development, and develops findings and recommendations for managers and senior leaders.
Analyzes and develops service proposals and business cases, including their operating, financial, resource, risk, benefit and performance implications.
Assists client departments in identifying opportunities to improve service outcomes, strengthen accountability, increase transparency and support value-for-money decision-making.
Applies structured problem-solving approaches to complex business, operational and service-delivery questions.


Analytics, Reporting and Data Quality


Develops and maintains datasets, reports, dashboards and analytical models using tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL and other business intelligence platforms.
Supports the development of user-friendly reporting products that help leaders and service owners understand performance, trends, risks and opportunities.
Works with client departments to identify and remediate data quality issues that affect reporting, analysis and decision-making.
Supports the team’s use of modern analytics platforms, including Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or similar tools, as required.
Contributes to the development of consistent reporting methods, data definitions and analytical approaches across the City.


Stakeholder Support and BI Adoption


Works with client departments to understand business needs, clarify decision questions and translate those needs into useful analytical products.
Supports adoption of business intelligence tools by developing guidance materials, providing training or coaching, and helping users interpret and apply performance information.
Builds effective working relationships with technical, professional and operational staff across the City.
Presents analysis clearly and appropriately for different audiences, including operational teams, managers and senior leaders.
Supports a culture of data-informed decision-making by helping departments use evidence to understand performance, improve services and make better decisions.
Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualification Requirements

Education and Experience:


A relevant master’s degree, such as Business Analytics, Commerce, Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, Public Administration or an MBA, or a professional designation, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience. Examples include a CPA.
Minimum 4–5 years of experience in performance measurement, data analytics, service or program evaluation, business analysis, business intelligence or a related field, ideally in a large, complex organization.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Considerable knowledge of performance metrics, benchmarking and service evaluation, with the ability to link operational and financial measures to service outcomes.
Considerable knowledge of business intelligence, analytics and automation tools to transform data into reliable, user-friendly reporting and decision-support products.
Considerable knowledge of business intelligence and analytics tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL and data modelling approaches.
Considerable knowledge of designing performance measures, indicators or evaluation approaches that inform strategic, operational or service-delivery decisions.
Ability to support corporate planning, service planning, business planning or enterprise reporting processes.
Ability to systematically frame and breakdown complex issues, opportunities or service questions, and reaches conclusions supported by evidence and sound judgment.
Ability to work with structured data, analytical models, data quality issues and modern BI platforms, with the ability to partner effectively with technical teams.
Ability to turn quantitative and qualitative information into clear findings, implications and recommendations.
Ability to present complex analysis simply and compellingly in writing, verbally and through reports, dashboards and presentations.
Experience supporting multi-stakeholder initiatives and presenting analysis to a range of audiences, including managers and senior leaders.
Ability to focus on accuracy, definitions and analytical detail without losing sight of the broader business or service context.
Ability to approach problem-solving with professional judgment, confidentiality, tact and diplomacy.
Collaborative. Builds effective working relationships with technical, professional, operational and senior management staff across the City.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects and deadlines in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Knowledge of Python, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power Automate or similar analytics, automation or cloud data platforms is an asset

Data Analyst

Toronto, ON | Montreal, QC

www.socan.com

POSITION TYPE: Permanent Full-Time

HIRING RANGE: $71,920 to $89,900

REASON FOR HIRING: Replacement

WORK MODEL: Hybrid

LANGUAGE: English, French is an asset

Who We Are

SOCAN is a not-for-profit copyright collective dedicated to ensuring music creators and publishers receive what they have rightfully earned for the use of their work. SOCAN supports and represents nearly 200,000 songwriters, composers, and music publishers. Through licensing, global royalty collection and advocacy, we help creators to keep making the music that entertains, moves, and inspires us

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION, AND ANTI-RACISM   

SOCAN thrives with a variety of viewpoints, identities, and backgrounds, and we are committed to anti-racism. Everyone is welcome to apply for our wide range of roles, regardless of gender identity, gender expression, ethnicity, race, age, culture, sexual orientation, religious belief, or physical ability. Learn more about SOCAN’s commitment to Inclusion & Anti-Racism.  

WHY WORK WITH US?


Make a difference by supporting and collaborating with a vibrant and creative community
Enjoy many options for workplace flexibility and work-life balance
Get involved in the rapidly changing creative space
Advocate for and empower the creative community
Together, we’ll help music creators earn more income and make a living


What We Offer


35-hour workweek schedule (possible flexible work options i.e., 4-day work week (position based)
Twelve paid sick days annually (including five personal days)
Access to SOCAN fitness facility
Annual Performance Incentive bonus (dependent on a personal and company performance)
Defined contribution Pension Plan
Comprehensive, health and dental benefits program
Inclusive and collaborative working environment 


About The Role

SOCAN is seeking a Data Analyst to join our Analytics department. In this role, you’ll be accountable for turning raw data into actionable business insights through various reports and dashboards, driving improvement in our key organizational initiatives. You must be comfortable working closely with data engineers, BI analysts, and business leaders. The ideal candidate has a solid grasp of data fundamentals and is eager, curious, and possesses a drive for continuous learning and self-improvement, especially with modern cloud data stacks.

The knowledge of English is required for this position as the position requires to interact on a constant and regular basis with English-speaking stakeholders outside of Quebec

What You’ll Do / Key Responsibilities


Work directly with data engineers, BI analysts, other data analysts, and business leaders to document reporting requirements and understand business processes and how they affect data.
Perform exploratory data analysis to clean, transform, and analyze large datasets within Databricks to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities to improve our data.
Support data quality assurance by creating data quality tests and plans for various reporting and Lakehouse projects that can assist in troubleshooting data discrepancies and pipeline issues.
Work with each department leader to define and document KPIs.
Perform root-cause analysis on KPI fluctuations to provide actionable insights to department leaders.
Collaborate on the continuous development of interactive Databricks AI/BI dashboards and reports, designing and maintaining clear dashboards to communicate findings to various stakeholders.
Curate and document semantic layers to power natural language querying (Genie) for business users.
Participate in, and contribute towards daily standup meetings, project planning sessions, and retrospectives.
Manage, prioritize, and respond to ad hoc requests for data analysis.


Required

WHAT YOU WILL BRING / QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE


Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to work on large data sets, while keeping the big picture in mind.
Strong SQL skills and intermediate Python. An understanding of Spark and distributed compute environments.
Experience and proficiency performing data analysis using Databricks or similar technologies (2+ years).
Strong communicator, with the ability to tackle loosely defined problems with a solution oriented mindset.
Business writing skills as well as the ability to create technical documentation, communicating clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Stats, Economics, Business Analytics) or equivalent experience.


Nice To Have


Passion & love for music.
Fluency in French


COMPETENCIES


Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
Emotionally intelligent
Commitment to Continuous Learning
Process Oriented

Should you require accommodations please contact us directly at hr@socan.com and we will make the necessary accommodations. Applications submitted to this email address will not be accepted.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Meridia Recruitment Solutions has partnered with the Nova Scotia Pharmacy Regulator (NSPR) on their search for a Data Engineer to join their team.




The NSPR is the regulatory body responsible for overseeing pharmacy professionals across Nova Scotia, ensuring safe, ethical, and high quality care for the public. NSPR's Research and Engagement team relies on strong data infrastructure and rigorous analysis to guide strategic, evidence-based decisions across all organizational functions, including registration, quality assurance, professional conduct, and policy..




Position Scope:

Reporting to the Director of Research and Engagement, the Data Engineer will act as the critical bridge between raw operational data and the strategic, evidence-based decisions that guide NSPR. The role combines Salesforce architecture with data engineering and quantitative research methods, transforming raw administrative data into statistically sound, meaningful insights.




Responsibilities:

Build, automate, and maintain ETL pipelines using Python, SQL, and Databricks, integrating data from source systems including Salesforce and Qualtrics
Establish and oversee Master Data Management (MDM) protocols to ensure data consistency and accuracy
Manage NSPR's cloud data warehouse within the Department of Health and Wellness' Health Cloud
Provide day-to-day Salesforce administration, including field mapping, configuration changes, and report generation, partnering with external developers on larger platform builds
Design, build, and maintain complex Salesforce reports and dashboards across multiple standard and custom objects
Design scalable data models and define KPIs to support regular reporting
Translate complex datasets into clear, visually compelling insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders
Execute annual reporting in alignment with the Regulated Health Professions Act and Canadian Institutes for Health Information requirements
Conduct descriptive and inferential statistical analyses to generate research briefs
Maintain strict adherence to data governance, privacy, and security standards




Position Requirements:

5+ years of experience in data engineering, data analytics, or business insights
Demonstrated experience as a Data Engineer, BI Developer, or Quantitative Data Analyst
Strong grasp of BI principles, Master Data Management, data modeling, and quantitative research design
Exceptional ability to translate data into insights that drive business action
Strong organizational, project management, and communication skills
Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with a high degree of integrity




Assets:

Experience working in regulation, healthcare, or a related field
Understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem, including Salesforce certifications
Experience with Microsoft Azure and Databricks
Hands-on coding experience with Python and advanced Excel
Formal training or working knowledge of quantitative research methodologies, biostatistics, or experimental design
Experience supporting or contributing to a data governance review or framework




To express interest in this opportunity please apply online by clicking “Apply Now” below:




For more information about this exciting opportunity please contact Jamie Grant, Partner, at jgrant@kbrs.ca or Nick Leadbetter, Senior Recruitment Specialist, at nleadbetter@kbrs.ca.




Applications are encouraged from racialized, Black, African Nova Scotian, and Indigenous Peoples, 2SLGBTQIA+, newcomers to Canada, and People with Disabilities. The NSPR is committed to accommodating applicants with disabilities throughout the hiring process and will work with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process. If you require accommodation to participate in the recruitment process, please let Nick know.

Title: Data Support Senior Consultant
Description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

The Central Data Support Team (CDST) is a part of the national audit center, audit support team. The CDST is tasked with implementing new technologies in the audit practice and providing digital and data & analytics services to our clients. The group works as part of a multi-disciplinary team providing and supporting KPMG proprietary and third-party data & analytics solutions to our teams.

Support consultants will work as part of the CDST to assist clients facing teams with data extraction, transformation, and load capabilities into our various audit tools. In addition, they provide critical support with data analysis, reporting and data visualization. This work will enable us to deliver innovative solutions to our clients.

This position requires written and oral fluency in English. The successful candidate may be required to support or collaborate with English-speaking colleagues or stakeholders while at KPMG. The successful candidate may be required to create, interpret and/or apply policies, practices, laws and and/or regulations during the regular course of their employment.

What You Will Do


Work with audit engagement teams to support the use of Data and Analytics (D&A) in the performance of external audits including data acquisition, movement and transformation; utilize a range of technologies and data capabilities such as Alteryx, SQL, Python, PySpark, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake Storage, Power BI and other Azure technologies
Communicate the technical implications of D&A capabilities to audit engagement teams; identify issues / challenges, and provide recommendations, opportunities, and mitigation strategies
Work with audit engagement teams to scope D&A capabilities, review analytic results and deliver innovative solutions that enhance audit planning and execution.
Collaborate with client technology teams to understand ERP environments and data architecture, assess the technical implications of data acquisition and analysis, and deliver clear, well‑structured audit documentation across the D&A lifecycle, while building long‑term client relationships through high-quality engagement delivery and professional networking
Participate in business development by identifying new opportunities and assisting with proposal development for a high-quality technology and data enabled audit


What You Bring To The Role


Bachelors or Diploma in Computer Science, Database Management, Data Programming, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, or other IT-related degree;
Strong database proficiency (e.g., SQL, My SQL, Oracle etc.) and experience in Microsoft SQL Server technology, MSBI suite (including SQL stored procedures and data modeling) or cloud technologies (Azure suite, Databricks pipelines in Python) for financial analysis
SQL code scripting, including creation/implementation of API’s and debugging ability.
Proficiency and knowledgeable with analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Python, R, Alteryx, Microsoft PowerApps is preferred.
Knowledge of data extraction tools and utilities and aptitude to quickly learn various technologies (MS Office, ERP systems, KPMG Audit tools, client applications, Azure cloud technologies)
Strong communication skills (verbal and written) - ability to work with multiple stakeholders and communicate priorities/ manage expectations
Proven time management and organizational skills
Comfortable managing diverse responsibilities from day to day administrative and operational work to project and deadline driven tasks
Resourceful and creative problem-solving skills- you are proactive and always bring new ideas and ways of working forward
Ideal candidate has experience in the Accounting and/or Finance industry Keys to your success
Ability to clearly articulate, identify and define problems and develop creative and practical solutions to address different and unique client requirements
Able to employ sound professional judgment and professional skepticism; flexible and adaptable team player; leadership experience; resourceful in delivering high-quality, detail-oriented deliverables; ability to demonstrate sound organization and project management skills


KPMG Ontario Region pay range information

The expected base salary range for this position is $66,500 to $101,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills, & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.

KPMG BC Region Pay Range Information

The expected base salary range for this position is $59,500 to $94,500 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills, & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.

Providing you with the support you need to be at your best

Our Values, The KPMG Way

Integrity, we do what is right | Excellence, we never stop learning and improving | Courage, we think and act boldly | Together, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences | For Better, we do what matters

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice.

Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process

At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1-888-466-4778.

AI Usage

We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Serving the needs of all families with young children, Carter’s Inc. is the largest North American apparel retailer exclusively for babies and young children, encompassing Carter’s, OshKosh B’gosh, Skip*Hop and Little Planet brands. Meaningful work, constant learning, genuine people, and a community guided by core values that promote inclusion and innovation is in everything we do. There are many reasons to build your career at Carter's.

How You’ll Make An Impact

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Data Analyst to support better and efficient decision making for the business. This role requires a combination of business acumen, technical skills, and the ability to translate data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in building and maintaining complex dashboards using BI tools used by the company and working with large retail datasets. This role will partner closely with business leaders in Canada as pricing, assortment, planning, and allocation capabilities are implemented and improved.

Planning Operations and Reporting (80%)


Design, develop and maintain reporting and act as a Tableau expert to create complex dashboards, standardized reports and self-service reporting solutions.
Perform data validation, quality assurance, and troubleshooting to ensure accuracy and consistency across reports.
Write and maintain SQL queries for advanced data analysis and data manipulation when needed.
Provide ad hoc reporting to the Planning & Allocation team as needed.
Supports teams with training on Tableau (or any other BI Tool adopted for reporting) and training material.


Relationship Management and Collaboration (20%)


Develop a strong collaboration with the corporate BI team for any added support.
Partners with cross-functional project leads and monitor project timeline at times in partnerships with different functions.
Support Retail senior leadership team with data, insights, and presentation materials on future capabilities and project status updates when required for larger projects, work closely with outside parties to implement solutions.


WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF: Must have:


2-3 Years of Experience in a Data Analyst role.
Advanced knowledge and proficiency in Tableau.
Strong SQL skills for querying large data sets.
Strong communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Skills And Experience


Degree or Diploma in Data Analytics or related field or equivalent work experience.
Exposure to Retail Planning, KPIs and fundamentals.


Our Team Members


Lead Courageously: Have a strong sense of personal values that align with our Company values
Collaborates Broadly: Build cooperation, trust, and thrive in a consensus driven environment
Customer Focus: Proactively seek opportunities to leverage data and fact-based insights to serve customers and/or internal clients
Drive Growth: Set aggressive goals and implement plans precisely
Cultivates Innovation: Respectfully challenge the “we’ve always done it this way” mentality and explore new ways to achieve desired outcomes


Make a Career At Carter’s


Career Development: Success starts from within, and we have several paths from which you can choose to


enhance your career evolution. From Carter’s University to Toastmasters to mentorship programs and more,

we encourage you to utilize these tools to elevate your professional prowess.

Title: Research & Enrolment Analyst
Description:
Job Description

This competition is open to all applicants however; internal candidates and applicants who were former employees of the University of Alberta will be given priority consideration before external candidates. Please log in to verify your internal candidate status.

There is also a 12-month temporary Research & Enrolment Analyst opportunity available. If you would like to be considered for both opportunities, please submit an application to both competitions.

Location - This role is hybrid with a mix of remote and in-person. Work primarily takes place at North Campus, Edmonton.

Reporting to the Assistant Registrar, Enrolment Research, Analytics and Insights, the Research & Enrolment Analyst plays an integral role by providing critical analysis and interpretation of enrolment data for strategic and tactical planning within the Office of the Registrar (RO) at the University of Alberta.


Generate, collect, analyze, and report data for enrolment projection/forecasting.
Conduct research to provide insight for strategic and tactical planning. This will often involve data sources both within and external to the university involving Advancement Services, Dean of Students, government agencies such as Apply Alberta, or other educational institutions.
Monitor the effect of initiatives and statistical results on Enrolment Services and Enrolment Management and provide analysis of the success of the initiatives on our student population.
Take the lead in identifying issues and providing direction with respect to the building and sharing of complex operational data reporting, provision of answers, and methods to obtain answers about the University of Alberta Student population to the Office of the Registrar Executive, and also make information available to Faculties, Departments and Administrative Units.
Respond to inquiries with evidence-based analyses to provide answers to questions from the Faculties, Departments, Administrative Units, University and Registrar Executive. When initiating new reports or agreements with university executives or external parties, negotiations are undertaken in collaboration with the Registrar or the Registrar’s executive team.
Keep relevant analyses up-to-date for immediate reference by the University and Office of the Registrar senior executive officers, planning and presentation units, and external partners.


Responsibilities


Take lead responsibility for analyzing trends in the following broad fields: Enrolment Services and Enrolment Management, including Local, National, and International students, as well as specific student populations such as Indigenous students.
Take a lead role in the Office of the Registrar's production of Business Intelligence.
In collaboration with the Assistant Registrar, Enrolment Research, Analytics, and Insights, develop, revise, monitor, and evaluate the enrolment reporting needs of the Office of the Registrar.
In collaboration with the Enrolment Management Service Partners and faculties, deliver necessary statistical and trend enrolment analyses to support planning; common areas of focus include demand estimates, admission criteria, recruitment priorities, and comparisons of student performance.
Conduct research analysis for the relevant data from existing sources or through new surveys, often in consultation with other internal offices such as the Enrolment Management Service Partners, portfolio teams under Deputy Provost Student and Enrolment, and faculties.
Develop innovative research projects to inform strategic planning and promote a culture of evidence-informed decision-making.
Develop necessary visualization tools to reflect enrolment trends and support enrolment management.
Collaborate with campus partners to ensure the relevance, consistency, and accuracy of data products and relevant behind-the-scenes logics, which involves discussions of methodologies and conducting the User Assessment Tests (UAT).
Carry out the necessary analytics, especially statistical, but also qualitative where appropriate, to explore and highlight nuances in key issues to provide answers to questions or develop positions.
Refine the analysis and information as determined in consultation with the requesting office or department.
Develop and maintain enrolment projections to ensure business leads within the Office of the Registrar and the Campus Community have relevant input for planning.
Prepare effective presentations of key research and analysis to be delivered either in person or electronically.
In response to requests that emerge from senior executives or management, consult as necessary to identify the particular questions that require analysis.
Work with communications and marketing to develop the annual enrolment report for internal and external audiences.
Conduct research and retain comparators from other institutions to facilitate comparing our business processes and performance metrics to best practices from other institutions.
Review resulting data compilations and reports to identify insights of significance to the University as well as any questions of validity and reliability.
Conduct consultations to gather insight on the needs of the RO and University community and ensure that the studies and reports published meet those needs.
Engage RO staff in understanding the value contained within the University’s data.
Keeps current on the methods and tools available within and external to our Enrolment Management and Reporting systems and recommends appropriate approaches and tools.


Qualifications


Related undergraduate degree in Social Sciences, Economics, Statistics, or related disciplines with excellent knowledge of statistical research and analytical methods and related software /technology.
Three years of experience conducting research and analysis (from information searches and selection through statistical compilation and analysis) that provides answers to critical questions within strategic time limits.
Expertise in both qualitative and quantitative aspects, preferably in a post-secondary environment.
Continuous upgrading of computer software (e.g., SAS, R, Python, Tableau, Excel), statistical and social scientific analytical skills as techniques and technology evolve.
Superior ability to work cooperatively with colleagues and with data specialists in other units and provide leadership in information gathering, trend analysis and predictive analysis.
Strong ability to analyze data, suggest recommendations, and present results to senior management.
Excellent written and oral communication skills for consultations and reports.
Excellent time management in balancing demands in a way that will ensure access to critical data, reports, or analysis within strategic time limits, including accurate preliminary estimates of project time expectations.

Title: Data Analyst, SMB Self-Serve
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data and analytics are at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to support our Self-Serve segment — the fastest-growing part of Lyft's B2B portfolio, serving small and mid-size businesses across North America. This is a hands-on role for an analyst who is energized by turning product and customer data into insights that shape strategy — and who builds those insights on a foundation others can trust and reuse.

You will be the dedicated analytical partner to the Self-Serve product team, measuring how new features — a redesigned signup experience, onboarding improvements, and lifecycle campaigns — drive customer activation and growth. You'll own the funnel from acquisition through engagement, define the metrics that matter, and deliver the insights that inform where the business invests next. The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a builder's instinct — turning recurring questions into well-defined, reusable datasets instead of one-off answers — and can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:


Produce high-impact analyses on Self-Serve performance that directly inform product and go-to-market strategy
Own the Self-Serve funnel — acquisition, signup, onboarding, and engagement — building the dashboards and datasets that give the team real-time visibility into product health
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to validate instrumentation and surface data gaps before they distort the funnel or new features launch — catching the data quality issues that stay invisible until someone goes looking
Turn recurring reporting into well-defined, reusable datasets, replacing one-off queries with durable foundations others can build on
Identify recurring workflows worth automating, and help build the prompts, context, and guardrails that make AI analytics tooling reliable for the wider team
Conduct deep-dive analyses and design experiments to establish conversion baselines, measure business impact, and uncover the “why” behind performance trends
Partner with Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to inform strategy and drive decisions
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally in a product, growth, or B2B context
Proficiency in SQL — able to write structured and efficient queries on large data sets
Experience with funnel analytics, conversion measurement, and A/B testing (preferred)
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Looker, Mode, or similar
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Familiarity with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, dbt) is a plus
Comfortable using AI coding and analytics tools — LLM assistants, agentic SQL/analysis workflows — to accelerate extraction, exploration, and reporting, while reviewing and validating every query, result, and insight before it reaches stakeholders; you own the correctness of the output, not the tool
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Description:
Our values start with our people, join a team that values you!

Bring your talents to Ross, our leading off-price retail chain with over 2,200 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. Our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high-quality brands and on-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. All while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.

As Part Of Our Team, You Will Experience


Success. Our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving
Career growth. We develop industry leading talent because Ross grows when our people grow
