Title: Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst
Description:
Location: Halifax - Wilkinson, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst

Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements


This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level



Key Areas of Responsibility


Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems.
Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests.
Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data.
Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments.
Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records.
Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements.



Chorus Role


Prepare and Deliver Customer Service



Minimum Qualifications


Technical System Expertise: Proven experience using both Maximo and DRMIS (or CGCS/CGCM) is mandatory.
Software Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills are essential (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, and complex data reconciliation).
Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA.
Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment.
Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently.



If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Preferred Qualifications


Data Analytics & Database Tools: Proficiency in Power BI and Microsoft Access is considered a strong asset.
Defense & In-Service Support Experience: Experience with DND In-Service Support (ISS) contracts and experience supporting an operational military asset.
Logistics Support Analysis Expertise: Familiarity with Logistics Support Analysis (LSA) and exposure to Logistics Support Analysis application software such as OmegaPS.
Technical Publications & Documentation Standards: Knowledge of Canadian Forces Technical Orders (CFTOs) and government-adopted technical publications.
Digital Technical Data Standards: Knowledge of the S1000D specification and Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) format.
Language Requirements: Bilingualism (English/French).



Special Position Requirements


Schedule: Core business hours Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week.
Physical Environment: Hybrid position – which is a mix of working from home and onsite (in office, at customer site or on-board ships alongside in harbour.
Physical Demands: Predominantly office work but may be required to work in dockyards and onboard Naval ships.
Travel: Occasional domestic travel maybe required in support of the ships.



What We Offer

The reference Total Target Compensation (TTC) market range for this position, inclusive of annual base salary and the variable compensation target, is between Total Target Cash (TTC) $74,146.88– $126,733.63 CAD Annual. This reflects how companies in a similar industry and geographic region generally pay for similar jobs. This range helps the Company make pay decisions as one data point among many. Where a position falls within this range is also dependent on other factors including – but not limited to – the employee’s career path history, competencies, skills and performance, as well as the company’s annual salary budget, the customer’s program requirements, and the company’s internal equity. Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst

Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements

  • This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
  • Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
  • Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level


Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems.
  • Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests.
  • Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data.
  • Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments.
  • Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records.
  • Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements.


Chorus Role

  • Prepare and Deliver Customer Service

  • Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA.
  • Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment.
  • Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently.

Title: Analyst, Offer Management & Optimization
Description:
This position requires in-person collaboration up to five days a week. This arrangement is subject to change based on business requirements.

Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. We’re proud to be one of Canada’s most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

Overview Of Role

As the Analyst, Offer Management & Optimization, you will tackle the complex puzzle of airline pricing by bringing WestJet's Offer Management strategy to life through data-driven execution. This role is focused on actively optimizing fares, designing dynamic bundles, and leveraging large datasets to test and deploy modern offer strategies.

Acting as a critical bridge between Commercial and Technology teams, working alongside Pricing, Revenue Management, Digital, Distribution, and external technology partners, you will ensure WestJet delivers innovative retailing capabilities that directly boost revenue and elevate guest value.

Key Responsibilities

Offer Execution & Optimization


Support the evolution and daily execution of WestJet's Offer Management capabilities across:
Fare price optimization
Ancillary price optimization
Dynamic bundle generation
Offer optimization and decisioning
Commercial experimentation and testing
Offer governance and configuration
Collaborate closely with Pricing and Revenue Management teams to ensure pricing strategies are effectively executed through Offer Management tools.


Cross-Functional Delivery


Manage day-to-day technical workflows with internal teams and external vendors, using tools like Postman to validate API requests, troubleshoot integrations, and ensure seamless offer delivery.
Participate in the business delivery of new capabilities by working with stakeholders across the organization including Pricing, Revenue Management, Distribution, Digital, Commercial Technology, Finance, and the Contact Centre.
Gather and document business requirements, coordinate testing, and assist with change management and release readiness to ensure successful implementations


Performance Management


Monitor product performance, build queries, and identify optimization opportunities by tracking key commercial metrics, including:
Revenue uplift
Conversion rates
Ancillary attachment
Bundle performance
Pricing effectiveness
Customer adoption
Provide regular reporting, dashboards, and actionable recommendations to leadership


Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
2–4 years of experience in data analytics, airline commercial strategy, pricing, revenue management, product management, or distribution
Experience supporting complex technology or commercial transformation initiatives
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and external vendors
Understanding of airline pricing and revenue management principles
Familiarity with Offer Management and Pricing Optimization concepts
Knowledge of airline retailing and distribution
Strong commercial and analytical mindset with proficiency in analyzing performance data
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights
Strong hands-on experience querying large relational databases using SQL on cloud platforms like Snowflake, and visualizing data in tools like Tableau or PowerBI
Familiarity with API testing and validation (e.g., using Postman) to support technical troubleshooting and vendor integrations is an asset


The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:


A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs


Think we’re a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. We’re Canada’s leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet's Alcohol and Drug Policy. 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. Title: Content Analyst
Description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

Job Description

The team:

We are a unified, collaborative marketing team focused on creating meaningful client connections that drive business growth. We combine deep insights with strong partnerships to deliver timely, relevant, and impactful experiences for our clients. Our team is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. We align closely with distribution partners to generate demand and unlock new opportunities across the business. Above all, we measure and optimize our efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value, drive engagement, and strengthen loyalty to Invesco.

The role:

The Content Enablement Content Analyst is a key role within Invesco’s Global Content Enablement team, supporting the Americas & EMEA Marketing organization. This position executes the content strategy and roadmap to enhance the quality, accessibility, and usability of content across the EMEA region. The role focuses on building and managing content infrastructure, ensuring accurate categorization, distribution, and access across platforms and audiences. It partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver consistent, well-governed content solutions and ensure requirements are clearly defined and tested. This hands-on role is critical to improving content quality and driving engagement, ultimately enabling a stronger client and investment experience.

Responsibilities of the role:

Provides analytics support primarily for EMEA content domains, with additional support for North America.
Partners closely with EMEA Content Product Owners to deliver analysis across development, deployment, and research initiatives.
Defines and standardizes content quality metrics, building reporting and dashboards to provide visibility into content performance for senior leadership.
Collaborates with EMEA and NA domain experts to develop and maintain global taxonomy, aligning stakeholders to standardized definitions and fields.
Bridges business and technology teams to ensure solutions meet requirements and align with strategic priorities.
Maps business processes, develops expertise in content sources, and provides recommendations to improve content effectiveness.
Translates stakeholder needs into user stories and supports execution of content initiatives, including testing, impact analysis, and cross-team coordination.
Leads governance and documentation efforts, including content quality monitoring, process improvement, issue escalation, and maintaining records in tools such as Jira and Confluence.


Requirements of the role:

Bachelor’s degree, 5+ years in technology platforms, project management, or content development and distribution.
Experience with CMS and/or DAM platforms, content lifecycle management, and content migrations, including API-based integrations.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content analysis and UX or digital marketing concepts.
Strong skills in workflow/process mapping, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
Advanced technical proficiency, including SQL and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables; VBA a plus), along with strong desktop tool capabilities.
Strong analytical and statistical reasoning skills, with ability to organize, analyze, and communicate large data sets with accuracy and attention to detail.
Knowledge of content categorization (campaign, program, asset class, product), with preferred experience in investment or asset management content.
Client-focused, execution-oriented professional with strong communication, organizational, relationship-building, and influencing skills, plus a data-driven approach to measuring content performance and impact.


The salary range for this position is $55,000 to $61,000 per year. The total compensation offered for this position includes salary and incentive pay and will vary based on skills, experience and location.

Full time

Worker Type

Employee

Job Exempt (Yes / No)

Yes

Workplace Model

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

Our people are at the very core of our success and we strive to provide employees with a competitive total rewards package which includes:

Hybrid working environment

Study Support

Title: Power BI Developer
Description:
About The Role

Job Overview:

As a Power BI Developer, you will play a dual role—developing impactful business intelligence solutions while also building strong relationships with potential clients. You will design, develop, and maintain business analytics dashboards and reports using Power BI to provide actionable insights for clients. Additionally, you will help explain the value of Power BI and other technology solutions to prospective clients, ensuring they understand how our offerings can solve their business challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement: Establish and maintain relationships with clients, understanding their data analytics needs and offering customized BI solutions.

Solution Development: Design, create, and manage Power BI reports and dashboards that transform raw data into meaningful insights.

Data Analysis: Work with clients to analyze business data, identify trends, and provide solutions that improve business performance.

Requirement Gathering: Collaborate with clients to understand their needs and translate them into effective Power BI solutions.

Technical Expertise: Advise clients on the best Power BI practices, data modeling, DAX expressions, and report optimization.

Sales Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to present Power BI solutions to prospective clients, demonstrating the value of data-driven decision-making.

Continuous Improvement: Stay up-to-date with Power BI features, and incorporate new tools and methodologies to improve client solutions.

Training: Provide client training sessions and documentation to ensure users can efficiently navigate and use Power BI tools.

Lead Generation Support: Assist in generating leads through strategic conversations and presentations that highlight our BI solutions.

Requirements

Qualifications:


Proven experience (3+ years) working as a Power BI Developer or Business Intelligence Specialist.
Strong technical skills in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX (Data Analysis Expressions), Power Query, and visualization best practices.
Experience with data integration from multiple data sources like SQL, Excel, and cloud-based databases.
Strong understanding of database management and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes.
Proven ability to understand client business challenges and develop technical solutions that address these issues.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple projects and client relationships simultaneously.
Familiarity with business process analysis and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.


About The Company

BI Control is a company that offers a wide range of innovative services to drive the success and growth of organizations.

We are a forward-thinking startup providing cutting-edge business technology solutions to help organizations optimize their operations. Our services empower companies with the data insights needed to drive better decision-making and growth.

We are looking for a passionate Power BI Developer to join our growing team and engage with clients, building solutions that drive business performance.

Vancouver is consistently ranked as one of the world’s most liveable and environmentally sustainable cities. The Decision Support Analyst is part of the City’s Centre of Expertise for Performance Measurement and Decision Support, within the Strategy and Project Support Office (SPSO). The role supports evidence-informed decision-making across the City by helping leaders understand service performance, assess options, evaluate outcomes, and identify opportunities to improve accountability, transparency and value for money.

The role combines performance measurement, service evaluation, business analysis and business intelligence to help leaders make sound strategic, operational and service-delivery decisions. A core part of the team’s mandate is enabling the delivery of an enterprise-wide corporate planning process and the evaluation of City services, ensuring decisions are grounded in consistent, comparable evidence.

The analysis considers operational, financial, resource and service-delivery implications and supports recommendations to managers and senior leaders.

The Decision Support Analyst partners closely with corporate and departmental teams to build a culture of data-informed decision-making across the City. This includes increasing data literacy, enabling data exploration, supporting adoption of business intelligence tools, and translating complex analysis into clear, decision-ready insight.

Specific Duties/Responsibilities


Performance Measurement and Corporate Planning
Supports performance measurement reporting by linking City services and service plans to performance metrics, departmental work plans and the corporate plan.
Supports the design and delivery of the City’s enterprise-wide corporate planning process, helping connect service plans, performance measures and corporate priorities.
Supports corporate, capital and service-planning processes by connecting service plans and performance information to operating requirements, costs and resource implications.
Develops, monitors and analyzes performance metrics and benchmarks to assess the efficiency, effectiveness and outcomes of City services.

Reviews and analyzes how major City decisions may affect service plans, performance measures and service-delivery outcomes.

Title: Portfolio Analyst
Description:
Detailed Job Description

Join us in enabling trade through Canada's largest port

The Vancouver Fraser Port Authority is an arm’s-length federal agency responsible for the shared stewardship of the lands and waters that make up the Port of Vancouver, Canada’s largest port. Our mandate, as outlined in the Canada Marine Act, is to enable Canada’s trade objectives on behalf of all Canadians, ensuring the safe movement of goods through the Port of Vancouver while protecting the environment and considering local communities.

As an organization with a significant impact on communities and businesses across Canada, the Vancouver Fraser Port Authority is dedicated to diversity, inclusion, and sustainability. We strive to create a workplace that mirrors the richness of our community, empowering all employees to achieve their full potential.

The Portfolio Analyst supports effective management of the VFPA project portfolio by maintaining, optimizing, and analyzing the Project Portfolio Management (PPM) systems and toolkits. This role ensures data quality, upholds portfolio metadata standards, develops dashboards, and enables consistent, reliable portfolio reporting and visibility across the organization.

Working closely with project leads, PMO team members, and at times under the direction of the Senior Portfolio Advisor, the Portfolio Analyst supports portfolio monitoring, reporting, and PPM system and toolkit improvements. The role provides early warning signals and strengthens the integrity of information used in portfolio decision-making by collecting, validating, and maintaining portfolio data and reporting outputs. This role supports the enabling of efficient and scalable portfolio management practices across the VFPA.

What You Do


Provide PPM systems and toolkits expertise by offering guidance and tooling support related to portfolio reporting, controls, and standard templates; identify knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to ensure PPM systems and toolkits remain accessible, current, and fit for purpose.
Maintain portfolio metadata standards to ensure consistency and integrity across the PPM system.
Improve the efficiency and quality of portfolio reporting and system support by leveraging process automation, dashboards, AI tools, and other technology-enabled methods.
Monitor portfolio data and indicators for projects within the VFPA project portfolio and prepare regular assessments of data quality, key project performance indicators, and qualitative factors.
Establish and maintain portfolio data quality standards and controls (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), track exceptions, coordinate remediation, and escalate material or recurring issues as required.
Analyze project and portfolio data to identify trends, exceptions, and emerging risks, and provide early warning signals to support portfolio review forums and decision support.
Liaise with portfolio stakeholders – including internal teams and, where applicable, external delivery partners – to collect, validate, and reconcile portfolio data in support of portfolio reporting needs. Prepare and maintain portfolio status updates, dashboards, and reporting materials to support portfolio review forums and decision making.
Identify and escalate data anomalies, material risks, and gaps in reporting to the Manager, Project Portfolio Management and Senior Portfolio Advisor for timely action.
Demonstrate and promote the effective use of PPM processes and tools. Produce materials and guidance to support adoption and knowledge transfer.
Identify planning and scheduling interdependencies and conflicts within the VFPA project portfolio.
Support the identification and integration of lessons learned and improvement opportunities arising from pre-project and post-project reviews led by project leads.
Contribute analytical, technical, and systems expertise to department innovations and improvements, supporting the PMO leadership team in enhancing PMO processes, tools, standards, and capabilities.
Perform other assigned duties as required.



What You Bring


Completion of a two-year full-time diploma in data analytics, data engineering, management information systems, business administration, supply chain management, or another acceptable field.
Minimum three (3) years of experience in data analytics, portfolio reporting or business systems administration with at least one (1) year of experience in project management.
Experience configuring or administering Smartsheet, Smartsheet Control Center, SharePoint, or workflow/automation platforms and experience demonstrating the use of these tools to others.
Completion of a relevant foundational project or program management designation (e.g. CAPM) is an asset.
Strong technical aptitude with the ability to learn, configure, and optimize business systems, including PPM tools, workflow platforms, and reporting dashboards.
Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, assess data quality, and develop meaningful insights.
Strong understanding of project management concepts, terminology, and lifecycle processes, with the ability to apply this knowledge to portfolio monitoring and reporting.
Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with project leads, technical teams, and PMO colleagues to clarify information and resolve issues.
Effective organizational and time management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.



What We Offer


Market-competitive base salaries and variable incentive plan
Flexible remote work program
Earned time off program
Paid vacation and personal care leave
Learning, development, and advancement opportunities
Onsite gym with towel service in a national landmark in the heart of Vancouver’s waterfront
Friendly, unique, and respectful workplace
Generous and inclusive benefits offering including retirement benefits plan



Location: Vancouver, Canada

Job type: Bargaining Unit, Full-Time, Permanent, Hybrid

Working environment: Normal office conditions. Flexibility to respond to issues during non-working hours as required.

MARINE TRANSPORTATION SECURITY CLEARANCE

The incumbent must obtain and maintain a valid Marine Transportation Security Clearance as this position is required to access restricted areas/information as defined by the Marine Transportation Security Regulations.

This is Canadian-based employment, and all employees are expected to maintain legal eligibility to work in Canada. Applicants advancing in the hiring process may be subject to technical assignments, psychometric assessments, and/or background checks, including but not limited to criminal record, credit, and/or reference checks.

At the Vancouver Fraser Port Authority, we are dedicated to employment equity and a workplace reflective of the diversity of our port community. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates including women, persons with disabilities, Indigenous peoples, and members of visible minorities. Reasonable accommodation can be provided in the selection process and while working with the port authority. If you require assistance with applying to our openings or are seeking accommodations to apply in an alternative format, please contact us at careers@portvancouver.com. We are committed to supporting your needs and will do our best to provide the necessary assistance.

Title: Jr. Data Analyst - ACX Corporate Support Edmonton
Description:
Join the ride!

Position : Jr. Data Analyst

Collision Centre: ACX Corporate Support Edmonton

Location: Edmonton, Alberta

Classification: Full-time, Immediate hire

Part of a bigger team!

ACX Corporate Support Edmonton is proud to be part of the AutoCanada Collision Centres’ network and a division of AutoCanada. AutoCanada is the largest Canadian owned and publicly traded automotive dealer group operating in Canada and the US. We are innovative, data-driven and our commitment to our Team Members, customers and operational excellence fuels our success. 

Our Team Members are at the heart of our success, building long-lasting, trust-based relationships with customers across Canada. Our national network provides opportunities and support to build the career that’s right for you. Working here is fast-paced, non-stop, and a little unpredictable—and we love it. 

Your area of focus.

You'll join the ACX (Collision Centre & Hail) Analytics & Innovation team at AutoCanada in an entry-level role focused on keeping our reporting suite running and helping migrate it from Tableau to Power BI. You'll grow into designing new dashboards, running data validation, and supporting stakeholders across our national collision repair network. Reporting into the Analytics & Innovation Lead, you'll get hands-on mentorship, direct exposure to shop managers, regional directors and senior leadership, and visibility into our AI and innovation work as your skills develop.

What drives your day-to-day?


Maintain and monitor the existing Tableau dashboard suite, ensuring reports run accurately and on schedule during the migration period.
Perform routine data validation across dashboards and reports, investigating discrepancies and partnering with Data Engineering when source data needs to be corrected.
Produce recurring monthly reports and one-off ad hoc reports for shop managers, regional directors and corporate stakeholders.
Manage the ACX user list across Tableau and Power BI, provisioning access and keeping permissions aligned with role.
Help rebuild ACX dashboards in Power BI — recreating calculations in DAX and validating that new versions match the originals.
As your Power BI skills develop, grow into designing new dashboards from scratch, contributing to dashboard digests, and helping train managers on how to use them.
Document your work so the rest of the team can pick it up.


What Are The Must-haves…


Post-secondary education in Operations Management, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Computer Science, ora related field — recent graduate's welcome.
Some hands-on experience with SQL or another programming language (coursework, co-op, internship or personal projects all count).
Working proficiency in Excel — formulas, pivot tables, and comfort cleaning up messy data.
An eye for visual design and a genuine interest in making data clear and engaging.
Self-starter mindset with the willingness to try something before asking for help, balanced with the self-awareness to ask good questions when you are genuinely stuck.
Strong written and verbal communication skills — comfortable talking with shop managers and regional leaders, not just other analysts.
Any prior exposure to Power BI (including DAX), Tableau, or another BI/dashboarding tool is a major plus. Power BI coursework, certifications (PL-300), or personal projects stand out given our current migration. 


The Perks.


Competitive Compensation and Benefits Package
Employee Vehicle Purchase & Service Plans

Description:
Business Analyst (Intermediate)

Position Details

Location: Calgary, AB
Contract Length: 2 Years
Schedule: Monday – Friday

Overview

The Business Analyst (Intermediate), functioning as a Master Data Analyst, reports to the Manager, Inventory Management and Master Data. This role is responsible for the creation, maintenance, and governance of master data supporting end-to-end business processes across supply chain, procurement, and finance.

The successful candidate will ensure high data quality, accuracy, and compliance with organizational standards while collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to improve operational efficiency and data integrity.

Key Responsibilities

Create and maintain master data using SAP, WinShuttle, MDM tools, and Microsoft Office.
Ensure adherence to master data governance standards, including approval matrices, data dictionaries, and process documentation.
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather accurate and complete data for system entry and approvals.
Manage intake requests with a focus on customer service, communication, and timely resolution.
Perform data validation, duplicate checks, and completeness reviews prior to entry.
Monitor and improve data quality through audits, integrity checks, and compliance reporting.
Use reporting and analytics to identify data gaps and lead continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with corporate policies and governance frameworks.
Analyze system data to maintain alignment with business processes and quality standards.
Support system enhancements, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and process improvements.
Develop and maintain documentation, training materials, and knowledge resources.
Conduct audits and report on data quality metrics.
Train and support business users, contributing to cross-functional knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

Minimum 3 years of experience in Supply Chain
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
Experience with SAP and LSMW/WinShuttle
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or related field
Supply Chain certification or progress toward certification (e.g., CPIM, CSCP, SCMP)
Experience with SAP S/4HANA
Familiarity with Power BI
Experience with Fieldglass
Background in supply chain functional areas such as:
Maintenance planning
Materials management
Warehousing
Experience in training, user support, or knowledge transfer initiatives

Title: Pricing & Reporting Analyst
Description:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Sr. Pricing Analyst

Location: Cottonwood Heights, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office)

About The Role

The Merchandise Planning team needs a data-driven analyst to own the day-to-day mechanics of pricing across Backcountry's four banners—competitive pricing audits, markdown execution, MAP/MSRP compliance, and the reporting that powers pricing decisions.

As Pricing & Reporting Analyst, you will work directly with the Sr. Pricing Analyst to maximize profitability through smart pricing execution. By 6–12 months, you will be running pricing operations independently, regularly making recommendations that move sell-through, margin, or working capital, and serving as the team's go-to for AI-augmented workflows.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

About The Role


Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next


What You'll Do


Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next


Required Qualifications


3–5 years of analyst experience, preferably in retail, ecommerce, or a related data-driven role
Demonstrated daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or similar) for real work—you iterate on prompts, evaluate outputs critically, and know when AI is the right tool versus when it is not
High proficiency with Microsoft Excel (pivots, lookups, formulas) and a strong aptitude to learn technical applications quickly
Solid understanding of retail math (margin, markdown, sell-through, IMU) and financial concepts (GMROI, NPV, CM%)
Awareness of customer pricing behavior—anchoring, discount perception, and how merchandising and pricing decisions land on a product detail page
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with messy datasets
Excellent attention to detail—pricing errors are expensive, and you treat that responsibility seriously
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate analysis into a clear, concise recommendation
Able to work both independently and collaboratively across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, or a related field preferred; equivalent demonstrated experience considered
Passion for the outdoor industry and knowledge of outdoor gear is a plus.


Why Join

The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.


Cross-Functional Impact: Your pricing work carries weight beyond the Pricing team—recommendations you make will shape decisions across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance.
AI-First Skill Building: AI is a first-class tool here, not a buzzword. You will use Claude, Copilot, and similar tools daily and actively shape how the team adopts them.
Real Ownership: This role pairs tactical pricing execution with strategic contributions. You will report to an experienced Sr. Pricing Analyst with growth-focused mentorship and high visibility from day one.
Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.


Interview Process


Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Sr. Pricing Analyst focused on your analytical approach, pricing experience, and AI tool proficiency.
Take-Home Assignment - A pre-built test requiring high-level analysis, the use and documentation of AI as a working partner, and advanced communication skills to convey complex business recommendations.
In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Cottonwood Heights office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

The Merchandise Planning team needs a data-driven analyst to own the day-to-day mechanics of pricing across Backcountry's four banners—competitive pricing audits, markdown execution, MAP/MSRP compliance, and the reporting that powers pricing decisions.

As Pricing & Reporting Analyst, you will work directly with the Sr. Pricing Analyst to maximize profitability through smart pricing execution. By 6–12 months, you will be running pricing operations independently, regularly making recommendations that move sell-through, margin, or working capital, and serving as the team's go-to for AI-augmented workflows.

  • Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis

  • High proficiency with Microsoft Excel (pivots, lookups, formulas) and a strong aptitude to learn technical applications quickly
  • Solid understanding of retail math (margin, markdown, sell-through, IMU) and financial concepts (GMROI, NPV, CM%)

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
A growing organization is seeking an eCommerce Data Specialist to play a key role in modernizing its online eCommerce product ecosystem. This position will focus on transforming large, complex product datasets, designing scalable catalog structures, and improving the processes used to manage product information across digital sales channels.




This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving data challenges, streamlining workflows, and building a foundation for future ecommerce growth.




What You'll Do

Redesign and optimize product catalog structures for a modern commerce platform.
Analyze, cleanse, and standardize large volumes of product data.
Create efficient processes for data imports, updates, validation, and ongoing maintenance.
Work with technical teams to align product information, business rules, and system integrations.
Improve digital asset organization, including product imagery and supporting content.
Evaluate and automate manual processes where possible.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and usability across ecommerce systems.

What We're Looking For

Experience working with large-scale product catalogs or digital commerce data.
Strong understanding of product taxonomy, catalog organization, and data governance.
Experience with data conversion, migration projects, or systems modernization initiatives.
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats, and data integration processes.
Ability to troubleshoot data quality issues and develop scalable solutions.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Experience

Product information management (PIM) systems.
ERP integrations and data synchronization.
Workflow automation or scripting experience.
High-volume product environments or highly configurable product offerings.
Digital asset management and ecommerce operations.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Highly visible role with significant impact on business operations.
Opportunity to shape long-term data strategy and best practices.
Blend of technical problem-solving, process improvement, and business collaboration.
Stable organization investing in its digital commerce capabilities.

Candidates with experience improving product data quality, streamlining catalog operations, or supporting digital transformation initiatives are encouraged to apply.


• At least 2 years of experience working on ecommerce platform migration initiatives.
• Hands-on knowledge of BigCommerce catalog architecture and platform capabilities.
• Experience designing product taxonomies, catalog structures, and data mapping strategies for ecommerce environments.
• Proficiency with ETL concepts, SQL, JSON, and data import or synchronization processes.
• Working knowledge of APIs and experience supporting system integrations or migration tooling.
• Familiarity with Python, Node.js, or similar scripting languages used for transformation workflows.
• Experience managing digital asset preparation, including ecommerce image formatting and organization.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to resolve issues in inconsistent or poorly structured legacy data.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Purpose of this Position:

The Enterprise Data Analyst is responsible for both designing and developing our data architecture and performing data analysis to support business decision-making. This role encompasses the end-to-end process of data collection, transformation, storage, and analysis. The Enterprise Data Analyst will work with departments across the organization to provide data solutions to our internal teams, ensuring data is reliable, accessible, and actionable, driving insights and strategic initiatives throughout the organization. They will also assist in deploying special projects for the other departments as requested.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes to support data reporting and dashboards.
Organize, model, and store raw data in our data warehouse and data lake.
Analyze and interpret data using statistical methods and tools.
Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate findings to stakeholders
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.
Ensure the reliability, efficiency, and quality of data by developing and implementing processes for data cleaning, transformation, and validation.

Competencies:

Ability to learn internal software and systems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage competing projects and priorities effectively.
Ability to interact with varying organizational levels confidently.
Ability to communicate technical information coherently to a variety of stakeholders.
Ability to confidentially interact with and interpret organizational information.
Strong analytical skills.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education/Experience:

Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of experience in data analysis, interpretation, and visualization; or an equivalent combination of education and experience, including 6+ years of experience in data analysis, interpretation, and visualization.
Experience with enterprise software or the transportation and logistics industry is a plus.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
Working knowledge of at least one major programming language (e.g., Python, C#, Java, or Scala) required.
Proficiency with statistical analysis and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) required.
Familiarity with big data technologies and platforms such as Delta Lake, Spark, and Databricks required.
Experience with SQL and relational databases is highly preferred.
Knowledge of schema design, data modeling, and data analysis is preferred.
Familiarity with data orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow, or Prefect is preferred.
Preferred certifications in Azure, Power BI, Data Analytics, or Data Engineering include, but are not limited to:
Azure Data Engineer Associate
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300)
Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
DataCamp Data Engineer Certification
DataCamp Data Analyst Certification
DataCamp Data Scientist Certification
Other related cloud, analytics, or data engineering certifications

Why McLeod?

At McLeod Software, we believe that our employees are our greatest competitive advantage. Each employee contributes directly to McLeod Software’s growth and success. When you join McLeod, you’re joining a company that’s built for the long haul—with a clear vision, strong leadership, and a commitment to investing in our people.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Description:
Department: University Advancement

Classification: Research Analyst 2

To be considered for this position, applicants must submit a complete application that includes (1) an online application, (2) a cover letter, and (3) a resume that addresses how they meet the minimum and/or preferred qualifications. Please include the position location (Eugene or Portland) you are applying for.

We are interested in finding the best candidate for the position. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t think you meet every one of our preferred qualifications- use your application to let us know what is meaningful to you about the role and what transferable skills or other qualities you would bring.

If you have questions about the application process or the position, please reach out to fass@uoregon.edu.

Department Summary

University Advancement (UA) supports the University of Oregon’s (UO) mission of providing exceptional teaching, discovery, and service by strategically positioning the university to create awareness, build long-term relationships, and secure resources that increase understanding and further its aims. The division consists of approximately 200 employees primarily working out of Eugene, with offices in Portland and Bend. We are committed to fostering equity and inclusion in a welcoming, safe, and respectful environment that recognizes the value of all members of our community.

The Advancement Strategies and Technology Innovation (ASTI) department is focused on finding the solutions for foundational issues that will best position UO Advancement to achieve its goals around engagement and fundraising. The department has a unique function in that it is based in UO Advancement, but also has strong working partnerships with The Office of Development as part of University Advancement has a mission to maximize philanthropic impact at the University of Oregon. We do this by identifying, connecting and engaging alumni and friends around the globe with their passions to advance the vision and priorities of the university.

Prospect Development is responsible for the implementation of the prospect management system and for the identification of prospects, strategic prospect review and providing intelligence for the purpose of aiding development officers in optimizing portfolios and fundraising to their highest capacity. This department's work is critical to the future success of fundraising at the University of Oregon and the Advancement initiative to identify the next generation of philanthropic leaders. Prospect Development collaborates with each development team and the department as a whole to promote a systematic and quantifiable framework through which development staff manage relationships and to analyze and identify prospects and related strategies.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Associate Director of Prospect Development, the Prospect Management Analyst audits and tracks prospect records while maintaining data integrity throughout the pipeline. Using a comprehensive knowledge of the Prospect Management System, this position reviews and revises policies, procedures, and reports, and engages key stakeholders in discussions and system review. In addition, this position conducts analytics and produces reports on prospect management data that provide essential information to development leadership and stakeholders about development activities and fundraiser performance.

With a customer service focus, the Prospect Management Analyst communicates, provides information, and strategizes with frontline fundraisers and their assistants on a regular basis. This position provides hands-on instruction for data input and information retrieval and plays an integral role in training fundraisers and Advancement staff on Prospect Management System policies.

The ideal candidate for this position will develop an in-depth knowledge of University Advancement’s donor database system that allows them to maintain data integrity by auditing their own work and that of colleagues. This position provides key services to constituents within the department and uses data visualization and analysis to provide information that informs department strategies and metrics. The Prospect Management Analyst should be able to work collaboratively, think independently, and work effectively with a variety of constituents and stakeholders. A PM Analyst that would thrive in this position is one who is detail oriented, enjoys working with large datasets, and can find patterns and impacts within the data to formulate a story of information.

Minimum Requirements

College level courses in statistics (at least six quarter hours); research methods and techniques (e.g., research

design, sampling, surveying, etc.); and computer software application or packages (e.g., Statistical Analyses System, Lotus 1-2-3, etc.);

OR

Three years of experience assisting with the gathering, compiling, analyzing, and reporting of research information and statistical data plus assisting with the drafting of this information into narrative or statistical reports

OR

An equivalent combination of training and experience.

Transcripts must be submitted for all required and/or related courses.

Professional Competencies


Ability to gain in-depth knowledge of a complex database system, including an understanding of how to use, support, modify and train others in the use of database systems.
Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Excel and Word.
Ability to exercise independent judgment, as well as operate as a productive team member.
Ability and willingness to work in an environment of frequent interruptions and competing priorities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including a willingness to proactively reach out to constituents and colleagues in person, via phone, and email.
Ability to build strong relationships with constituents, including developing rapport and trust.
Ability to interpret, analyze, and visualize data.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and adhere to the highest ethical standards.
Ability to interact, communicate, and work effectively with individuals, recognizing and respecting the many and varied identities of each person.
Commitment to promoting and enhancing diversity, equity, and inclusion.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience providing training on complex systems and/or internal policies and procedures.
Experience with Salesforce CRM database..
Experience with Tableau or other data visualization software.
Experience working in higher education development.
Experience in developing and maintaining policies and procedures.


FLSA Exempt: No

All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We are looking for you to join our team as a Data Analyst. This position focuses on data analysis for law enforcement support, requiring a combination of investigative data expertise, analytical skills, and the ability to work under high-pressure, mission-critical environments. This role will involve working with diverse data sets, ensuring accuracy and integrity while supporting ongoing criminal and civil investigations.

Our ideal candidate has a blend of technical acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to engage with law enforcement agencies. We are looking for more than just a "Data Analyst"—this role requires a technologist with excellent communication skills, customer service, and a passion for data and problem-solving.

Contributions

Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis and Trend Recognition: Compile and analyze data from multiple sources, identifying trends across various data sets, locations, and targets.
Data Accuracy and Assessment: Monitor data for accuracy, integrity, authenticity, and relevancy. Identify intelligence gaps and assess data viability for investigative purposes.
Investigative Support: Collaborate with teams to examine data gathered from criminal and civil investigations, developing methodologies to exploit investigative information.
Quality Control & Reporting: Participate in the development of work products, conducting periodic progress reviews and ensuring quality control of findings. Regularly report findings to lead personnel.
Data Entry: Perform data entry from both hard and soft copies into large-scale data processing systems, utilizing tools like optical character readers, scanners, and digital cameras as appropriate.
Law Enforcement Support: Provide critical law enforcement support, interacting with various agencies through multiple channels of communication, while managing data under tight timelines in a high-pressure environment.
Data Visualization and Tools: Leverage MS Excel, Power BI, or similar tools to design and build formulas, charts, pivot tables, and manipulate unstructured data from different platforms.
You will be part of our Data Exploitation Practice!


Qualifications

Required:


Ability to hold a position of SECRET clearance level with the US government.
4 years of Military or law enforcement background or exposure.
Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of work experience OR 9 years of work experience and no degree.
3+ years of experience in SQL and Python
5+ years of experience using data analytic/visualization tools such as MS Excel, Power BI, or others to design charts, create formulas, and analyze unstructured data (can be job or education-based).
2+ years of experience manipulating unstructured data from different platforms; and experience in IT, statistics, computer information systems, auditing, investigative, mathematics, and units of measure
Skilled at multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment while maintaining clear communications with stakeholders.
Must be local to El, Paso TX or willing to drive on site 5 days a week.
Applicants selected will be subject to a Government background investigation and must meet eligibility and suitability requirements.


Preferred


Law enforcement/drug data desired.
Ability to manage multiple tasks in a high-paced environment, including collaboration with various teams.
Strong analytical skills for identifying trends, gaps, and ensuring data accuracy and
Experience with documenting processes and developing SOPs for data handling and
Demonstrated experience in reverse engineering and validation of data processes.
Ability to communicate findings and updates effectively during briefings and team

Steampunk relies on several factors to determine salary, including but not limited to geographic location, contractual requirements, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience. Factors Group are a local and fast-growing manufacturing and health and wellness company where your work will have a direct and meaningful impact on business growth. Job Status: Permanent, Full-time

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 4:30pm

Location: Hybrid – 2000 Brigantine Drive, Coquitlam, BC

Salary: $75,000 – $90,000 per annum

Analyze and interpret data from multiple business systems to support informed decision-making.
Design and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, and Excel.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Data Analyst is the single point of accountability for the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of Allied Business Solutions' core business data across our ERP, CRM, and PSA platforms. This is a hands-on, technical role focused on keeping data clean, aligned, and trustworthy as it moves between systems — through disciplined data standards, active auditing, direct ownership of integrations and data synchronization, and targeted automation that eliminates manual entry and enforces quality. The Data Analyst ensures that every department works from a single, reliable source of truth, and provides reporting that turns well-governed data into usable insight for sales, service, and finance.




Key Responsibilities:




Cross-System Data Stewardship & Integrity

Serve as the single point of accountability for data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across the ERP, CRM, PSA, and related business systems.
Establish and enforce data standards, naming conventions, and entry rules so records remain consistent across systems and users.
Perform regular audits to identify and resolve errors, duplicates, gaps, and cross-system mismatches.
Own master and reference data (customers, products, pricing, equipment) so a single source of truth is reflected consistently everywhere it appears.
Maintain data dictionaries and documentation covering field definitions, ownership, and standards.

Data Integration & Synchronization

Own the flow and synchronization of data between the ERP, CRM, PSA, and other platforms, ensuring records stay aligned across all systems.
Write and maintain SQL queries to validate, extract, and reconcile data.
Build and maintain API-based integrations; troubleshoot sync failures and drive root-cause resolution with vendors or internal stakeholders.
Monitor integration health and proactively catch and correct data drift before it reaches downstream teams.

Automation for Data Quality & CRM Workflows

Design, build, and maintain automated routines that reduce manual entry and enforce data quality — deduplication, validation, reconciliation, and exception alerting.
Build and maintain CRM workflow automations that streamline sales and service processes and keep records current.
Document automations and adapt them as business needs evolve.

Product, Pricing & Proposal Data

Maintain accurate product records, configurations, and pricing across systems.
Keep proposal templates and pricing data current so quotes and proposals generate from clean, correct source data.

Lease & Asset Data Reconciliation

Maintain lease and asset records and reconcile them against related data across systems for consistency.
Monitor key dates — renewals, expirations, and term changes — and flag them to the appropriate stakeholders.

Reporting & Data Support

Generate routine and ad hoc reports to support the sales, service, and finance teams.
Support cross-departmental data requests and help translate data into usable insight.
Identify opportunities to improve data workflows, accuracy, and reporting efficiency.




Qualifications:




Required

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Proven experience managing data across CRM, ERP, PSA, or comparable business systems.
Hands-on SQL skills for querying, validation, and reconciliation.
Experience building and maintaining integrations (APIs) and troubleshooting data-sync issues.
Experience with process automation.
Strong attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working with large datasets.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Preferred

Familiarity with data governance and master data management practices.
Experience with data reporting and visualization/dashboarding tools.
Familiarity with lease or asset tracking systems.
Scripting for automation (e.g., Python or PowerShell) or experience with low-code automation platforms.
Background in the managed IT, technology, or copier/print industry.

Competencies

Ownership and accountability for data integrity
Problem-solving and analytical thinking
Technical aptitude and adaptability
Clear written and verbal communication
Dependability and follow-through
Collaboration across teams

Description:
NFI Parts™ is North America's most comprehensive organization providing parts, technical publications, training, and support for buses and motor coaches. NFI Parts is the parts division of NFI Group, providing replacement parts for New Flyer® transit buses, MCI® motor coaches, ADL buses, ARBOC® vehicles, as well as the product lines for the acquired NABI and Orion parts businesses. Additionally, NFI Parts has extensive cross references for parts that are common with other bus, coach, and cutaway product lines and has a mature supply base and established relationships with over 1,000 suppliers. Further information is available at www.nfi.parts.

POSITION GOAL:

Support a critical initiative aimed at eliminating part identification inconsistencies, incorrect cross references, and outdated product information that result in lost sales opportunities and customer confusion. This role is responsible for cleaning, managing, and maintaining the integrity of parts data across systems - ensuring accuracy, standardization, and usability for both internal teams and customers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Initial Data Clean-Up


Audit and correct part naming conventions across multiple data sources
Re-establish and validate product relationships, including obsolete parts, alternates, supersessions, kits, and subcomponents
Standardize and validate cross-reference data, including OEM and vendor cross references
Identify and remove redundant, outdated, or unreliable written notes that hinder searchability
Ensure significant product data is accurately displayed in the e-commerce platform
Review, revise, or remove attachments (customer documents, photos, PDFs, drawings) to ensure accuracy and relevance
Reclassify parts into correct Category/Set/Class structures to improve catalog consistency ensuring new structure is communicated to Pricing Dept


Ongoing Data Management


Monitor and resolve data discrepancies in real time, ensuring alignment between ERP, catalog, and e-commerce systems.
Ensure all product relationships remain accurate, including replacements, alternates, and component groupings.
Revise customer-facing attachments and information to support correct and current product details.
Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, Procurement, Customer Service, and Business Systems to ensure data accuracy across all platforms
Maintain detailed documentation of data changes, rules, and governance standards


Process Improvement & Governance


Design and document scalable data governance workflows to support long-term data integrity.
Recommend system enhancements to improve product data handling, visibility, and consistency.
