Title: Reporting Analyst
Description:
Lynden Door in Lynden, WA has an immediate opening for a Reporting Analyst. At Lynden Door we strive to be a relational company that provides world class industry leading quality, value, service, and innovation.

Role Overview

The Reporting Analyst supports business leaders and core team members by maintaining costing, price guides and other sales tools, and by providing timely and accurate reporting and analysis of business operations. The Reporting Analyst will have the opportunity to build momentum in our ongoing transformation of data and enhancing our platforms and business processes.

Do you love turning raw numbers into decisions that actually move a business? We're looking for a Reporting Analyst to be a go-to person for pricing, costing, and performance data across our organization. If you are someone who is confident writing SQL queries and leveraging PowerBI, finds real satisfaction in clean data, performs reasoned analysis, and appreciates high-functioning excel-based business tools, read on!

Hours: Full-time, in-office, 8:00- 5:00 Monday to Friday.

Responsibilities


Perform margin and pricing analysis to support key business initiatives.
Own and maintain Costing Books alongside Estimating, Sales, and Purchasing.
Manage Residential price books — including deep-dive margin and price gap reviews.
Manage Commercial/Architectural Price Guides and multipliers.
Leverage Power BI to create and maintain production reporting.
Work with a broad range of stakeholders to understand and document their data needs.
Establish and maintain connections between data sources and solutions.
Employ reporting and data modeling best practices.
Partner with stakeholders across the company to understand and document their data needs.
Work with Production to build consistent costing methodologies for material, labor, and freight.
Surface margin performance trends tied to mix shifts and volume commitments.
Build ad-hoc reports and dig into data issues — researching root causes, correcting master data, and documenting solutions.
Maintain department KPIs and help evolve how the whole team experiences reporting.


What You Bring


Knowledge and experience writing SQL and leveraging PowerBI.
Strong organizational skills and sharp attention to detail.
A problem-solving, analytical mindset.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive data.
Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust across teams and cultures.
A collaborative, service-minded approach to work.


Role

What Makes This Role Rewarding for a Data-Minded Person:


You'll own the numbers that matter. From margin analysis to KPI tracking, your work shapes pricing strategy and business decisions — not just reporting after the fact.
Variety. Solving pricing puzzles, investigating data discrepancies, and translating findings into action across multiple business functions.
Excel is your playground. This role rewards advanced Excel skills — building, modeling, and collaborating at a level that goes well beyond most user's knowledge and ability.
Ad-hoc analysis means chasing down root causes, cleaning up master data, and documenting solutions that stick.
Cross-functional work. Partner with Estimating, Sales, Purchasing, and Production, giving you visibility into how data connects every part of the business.
You'll help shape how the company's platforms and reporting processes grow and improve — not just maintain the status quo.


Compensation And Benefits


Hourly Wage $25 - 32/Hr DOE
Medical/Dental/Vision insurance and Health Savings Accounts (HSA's) with employer contributions $500 - $1,500 annually
401(K) options including profit-share eligibility after 1 calendar year of employment.
8 Paid Holidays
2-3 Weeks Paid Time Off
Paid Bereavement Leave


More About Us

We are an equal opportunity employer and one of North America's leading manufacturers of quality residential and commercial interior wood doors. The great service and products we deliver are a result of the hard work and talent of our exceptional team. We work very hard to hire the best team members who share our core values in respect for all people, integrity in every situation, and quality in everything we do. A supportive team with diverse backgrounds and career experiences from all around the world strengthens who we are and provides many opportunities for continuous growth and development within our Company.

This job is Safety Sensitive and therefore is contingent upon a pre-employment drug test including marijuana. Additionally due to dealing with sensitive data and systems, a Criminal Background Check will be required for this role.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical, business-oriented Data Analyst to support the Print Supplies business. This position sits at the intersection of analytics, data quality, product data stewardship, monthly reporting operations, and forecasting enablement. In this role, you will partner closely with data engineers, data scientists, and the supplies forecasting teams to ensure data processing pipeline integrity, maintain key business reference and enrichment data, and automate data verification and acceptance processes.

Responsibilities


Own and support monthly validation processes for print telemetry outputs, dashboard semantic layers, and related usage/share reporting handoffs
Serve as a key analytical partner for Forecasting and business stakeholders, helping answer usage, share, installed base, product readiness, and release approval questions through structured analysis and clear communication
Develop and maintain automated and well-documented processes that support recurring validation, issue diagnosis, data quality checks, and stakeholder decision-making
Conduct root-cause analysis on data discrepancies across sources, grains, tables, dashboards, and processing layers, especially where definitions, filters, platform coverage, or reporting timing create mismatches
Provide consultative support for quick-turn ad hoc requests, escalation support, and deep-dive investigations while helping route work through the appropriate intake, prioritization, and transition processes
Collaborate with dashboard, data engineering, and business intelligence partners to improve transparency, repeatability, and maintainability of analytics outputs
Provides guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members
Applies advanced subject matter knowledge, leads, and contributes to complex projects, and exercises independent judgment in resolving business issues and establishing policies
Develops and builds productive internal/external working relationships and may provide mentoring and guidance to lower-level employees


Education & Experience Recommended


Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
Typically has 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, database management, statistical analysis, or a related field.


Knowledge & Skills


Analytics and problem solving: exploratory analysis, root-cause analysis, metric design, data validation, anomaly detection, and ability to diagnose complex data issues across multiple factors
Data quality and governance: profiling, anomaly detection, metric validation, documentation, data lineage, privacy awareness, and the ability to communicate quality risks and remediation paths
Business intelligence and visualization: experience with Power BI, Qlik, advanced Excel, or similar tools to build stakeholder-ready dashboards, analyses, and presentations
Python for data analysis, validation, automation, time-series analysis, reproducible workflows, and tooling to support recurring quality checks and investigations
SQL, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query performance optimization
Databricks and modern analytics tooling: ability to work in notebooks, queries, dashboard-supporting datasets, and AI-assisted development environments while maintaining reproducible and reviewable outputs
Forecasting and time-series: ability to support forecasting partners, interpret restatements and metric volatility, and contribute to forecasting automation or time-series analysis workflows
Applied statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, and basic experiment/pre-post evaluation (role-dependent)
Strong documentation habits for code and process development, data analyses and investigations, data lineage, and stakeholder guidance. Familiar with version control (e.g., Git), Jira, and Confluence


Cross-Org Skills


Effective Communication
Results Orientation
Learning Agility
Digital Fluency
Customer Centricity


Impact & Scope


Impacts function and leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives.


Complexity


Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
A Brief Overview

This position builds databases, data pipelines, and dashboards, and performs queries to generate relevant information, and interpret and communicate results. This position analyzes and makes recommendations to improve database, query, and report functioning. This position designs and implements data discipline, quality assurance, data sharing, and legislative compliance. This position also updates and maintains the data catalogue and metadata repository. To be successful in this position, proficiency in Power Automate including the ability to develop and deploy Copilot Studio agents with custom Power Automate flows is essential.




What you will do

Builds databases, data pipelines, and dashboards.
Builds database queries to generate relevant information, and interpret and communicate results.
Develops and maintains reports, dashboards and visualizations.
Performs data analysis using statistics and modeling and creates reports.
Analyzes and makes recommendations to improve database, query, and report functioning.
Interprets data needs, and determines which data sources to use.
Supports staff on use of systems, troubleshoots issues that may arise, and communicates problems to technical resources.
Designs and implements data discipline, quality assurance, data sharing, and legislative compliance.
Updates and maintains the data catalogue and metadata repository.
Serves as a liaison between technical and non-technical resources.
Designs, develops, and delivers educational material for a range of data management workshops.
Other duties as required in support of the department and/or unit.




Required Education

Four-Year Bachelor Degree or equivalent. In addition, requires trade certification, qualification, or on-going learning to remain ahead of changes in technology or emerging fields.

Required Experience

More than 3 years and up to and including 5 years of experience.
Experience with Microsoft Power Automate considered an asset.
Familiarity with Copilot Studio Agents, including integration with Power Automate (Power Flows), considered an asset.
Consideration may be given to an equivalent combination of education and experience.




Job Knowledge and Requirements

Knowledge of concepts and principles in a specialist field that is typically acquired through a combination of advanced professional or academic qualifications and/or substantial work experience.
Provide effective consultation and advice on non-straightforward and/or complex issues.
Interaction with others requires interpersonal skills and the ability to understand and influence.
Adapt messages to meet the different needs of different audiences.
Builds relationships, trust and credibility.
Prioritize and distribute work to deliver objectives on time and to the highest standard.
Identify in advance when the intended results may not be achieved and develops a plan to address the gaps.
Actively participate in project team meetings and develop individual and unit project plans.
Lead procedural or technological change within a unit.
Identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of work processes.
Seek information and input to fully understand the cause of problems.
Appropriately assesses risks before making a decision.
Contribute to the creation and evaluation of possible solutions.
Take action to remove obstacles and address problems before they impact performance and results.
Apply equity, diversity, accessibility, inclusion and Indigenization considerations to decision making and planning.
Promote a work environment that is free from sexual violence, harassment and discrimination, and the ability to show empathy for those who have experienced trauma.

Back up for Process Assistant duties

2+ years of professional or military experience

1+ years of project management experience

Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Position: Data Analyst II

Department: Office of Strategic Initiatives & Development (SID)

Dept. Supervisor: Strategic Initiatives & Development Director

Compensation Range: $25-$30 per hour DOE with benefits

Summary Of Duties And Responsibilities

The Data Analyst II is a grant-funded position housed in the Office of Strategic Initiatives & Development (SID) of the Coeur d’Alene Tribe and will report to the SID Director. This position will work closely with SID staff to enhance systems alignment for the collection and analysis of data from multi-agency partners, including compiling crime and public health & safety reports to share with Tribal and non–tribal partners. This position will work closely with other agencies and departments to design, coordinate, and implement research, plans and interventions to address identified public health & safety gaps and issues. The Data Analyst II position will work with Tribal departments to enhance and implement data collection/case management systems, including the Coeur d’Alene Tribal Assistance Network (C-TAN) aka OasisInsight.

The ideal candidate will have excellent analytical, written and verbal communication skills, the ability to prioritize and work on multiple projects in a fast-paced environment, work efficiently in all team and workgroup elements and must possess time management skills to meet deadlines. The duties shall include, but are not limited to the following:


Collects, analyzes, disseminates and evaluates crime, substance use, public health and related data to discover developing trends, patterns, and changes in criminal activity (including recidivism) and overall public health & safety on the Coeur d’Alene Reservation.
Responsible for disseminating data trends and interventions through website and e-mail newsletters and/or other dissemination avenues.
Develops and generates various reports/bulletins identifying public safety, criminal activity, individual profile history, and crime trends.
Facilitates the transfer of data and information between the SID office, the TCC, and relevant partners.
Serves on a team that focuses on capacity building in the areas of research and evaluation including implementation of trainings on data security, integrity and data visualization to help staff better communicate and interpret their data.
Coordinates and facilitates meetings with various departments and agencies to successfully carry out the actions of the Tribe’s strategic plan, including the development of interventions to reduce and/or eliminate substance use and crime on the reservation.
Provides training and technical assistance to program managers, directors and staff that will enhance data collection and analysis efforts for the Tribe.
Promotes a trauma-informed and culturally responsive environment in Tribal departments and agencies through facilitation and/or coordination of training and materials.
Performs procurement/budgeting and reporting duties as needed such as the monitoring and purchase of equipment, software and supplies.
Leads in compiling programmatic reports and surveys to monitor project performance, and any other related grant requirements.
Leads in preparation of executive level presentations of specific reports or assignments related to data analysis.
Advises and develops policy and procedure recommendations for partnering departments.
Attends appropriate agency, program and team meetings and in-service trainings, as needed.
Upholds and helps with development of strict confidentiality protocols related to data collection, sharing and reporting.
Communicates with medical professionals, caseworkers, law and order staff, and Tribal staff about service needs and issues.
Assists the SID staff with daily activities or other duties as assigned to ensure it meets department needs.
Represents the Coeur d’Alene Tribe by displaying courtesy, tact, consideration, and discretion in all interactions with other office personnel, the general and professional public, and on social media
Maintains a positive, helpful, constructive attitude and working relationship with departmental employees, other employees, elected officials and the public.



Minimum Qualifications


Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university (submit a copy w/ application) with major course work in behavior or computer science, statistics, political science, public or business administration or a closely related field, which includes course work in research and statistical methods; Master’s Degree preferred;
Three years of increasingly responsible experience with data collection, performing statistical research and analysis, and presenting and disseminating data and statistics.
Three years of experience working with justice systems partners in the areas of public health, public safety, criminal justice, and substance use preferred.



Knowledge of:


Basic organization and functions of Tribal law enforcement and criminal law, related to crime analysis and dissemination of confidential information.
Modern research techniques including research design and statistical analysis.
Coding languages commonly used in data analysis, such as Python, R or SQL.
ETL processes to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources into reporting systems and data warehouses.
Applications of various software programs, including spreadsheet, database, word processing, graphics, and survey systems.



Demonstrated ability to:


Gather, assemble, analyze and evaluate facts and evidence and draw logical conclusions and make proper recommendations.
Prepare clear, concise, and comprehensive written reports.
Prepare graphs, tables and statistical charts.
Develop and maintain crime, public safety, and substance abuse analysis, data collection systems, and reporting procedures.
Facilitate trainings for potentially large groups as needed.
Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
Initiate, establish, and maintain cooperative working relationships with Tribal departmental and agencies employees.
Ability to understand and provide respectful and effective care and services responsive to all, but particularly to the diverse cultural beliefs and practices of the Native American population.
Use and analyze existing tools and databases to provide software solution and data collection, sharing and reporting systems recommendations.
Translate data collection and reporting conditions into non-technical, lay terms.
Must be able to work with limited or minimal direct supervision.
Must protect against unauthorized access to confidential information, ensure the security and privacy of such information, and disclose any anticipated threats or hazards to such information.
Be reliable, dependable, professional, and punctual.
Must be willing to occasionally work flexible hours to meet deadlines or attend evening meetings.
Must be able to meet program deadlines.
Must possess a valid driver’s license at time of application and during employment, and be fully insurable (attach a copy).
Must be at least 18 years of age at time of application.
Must not be an active Indian Child Welfare or Tribal Court client.



Please Note: An applicant may be asked to participate in an interview to establish whether he/she meets the minimum qualifications. Interviews do not create a right to employment and provide no promise or guarantee of employment with the Tribe.

The Coeur d’Alene Tribe reserves the right to hire according to its Indian Preference Policy. Applicants are subject to a pre-employment drug test and at-random testing following employment. Positions with the Coeur d’Alene Tribe are subject to a 6-month orientation period.

Who We Are

Price Industries Limited, North America’s leading manufacturer and distributor of air distribution products (www.priceindustries.com). The founding principles of Price have never changed – business integrity, first-class service, innovation and a commitment to people. Our dependable quality, reliable delivery, and knowledgeable follow-up service have made Price a market leader in supplying air distribution, critical controls, and noise control products.

After more than 60 years, Price remains a privately held family company with a deep heritage and commitment to innovation and service. Our long-standing vision, values, and the Price way of doing business are the cornerstones of our success.

We are a dynamic, progressive and innovative organization looking for new talent in our growing Winnipeg manufacturing facility. If you thrive on new challenges, and working in a friendly, team-driven environment, you should consider the following opportunity.

What You Can Expect


Health and Dental - Employees and their families enjoy paid benefits covering an extensive list of medical and dental expenses and services.
Manulife Virtual Pharmacy - Access pharmacy services anytime, anywhere through the Manulife app, with eligible prescriptions delivered directly to your home.
Manulife Mental Health and Counselling Services - Access confidential mental health and wellness support through the Manulife app, with convenient options to book counselling, consultations, and guided programs all in one place.
Life and Disability - You will be provided with life insurance in a multiple of your salary with an option to purchase additional coverage.
Pension Matching Program - Invest in your future with each pay cheque through our Defined Contribution Pension Plan and we will match your contribution (up to 3% of your salary).
Wellness Reimbursement Program - Employees are eligible for a fitness centre or club membership reimbursement of up to $300 per year, this includes Fitness related App’s.
Personal and Professional Development - We are committed to helping you reach your potential through training and education.
Community Involvement - Generously supporting health, charities, youth, and education opportunities is our passion, and you’re invited to be a part of that.
Our convenient Price Café offers free Tea and Coffee.


Purpose

Serve as the primary point of contact for ERP data and reporting at the site, ensuring alignment between corporate data strategy and plant operations by supporting data accessibility, reporting continuity, and informed decision making throughout the IFS ERP implementation.

The Successful Candidate's Responsibilities Will Include

Data Consultation & Navigation


Support the data domain throughout the ongoing IFS ERP implementation, ensuring all data-related activities contribute toward the final goal of system commissioning.
Guide users through the organization's data landscape, helping users locate specific data points, dashboards, and KPI information within existing systems.
Consult with business units to support users understand available data resources.
Serve as the liaison between the corporate data team and plant users, translating data strategies into actionable operational insights.
Provide expert guidance to users on data accessibility, ensuring users have timely access to the information required to support informed operational and business decision-making.


Reporting Continuity & Analysis


Gather, interpret, and document reports from existing systems to ensure the new IFS platform delivers equivalent or enhanced reporting capabilities post-implementation.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends and anomalies, translating technical data into meaningful insights that reflect real-world manufacturing conditions.
Develop a deep understanding of where data originates and what it represents in a production environment.


Data Triage & Corporate Alignment

Title: Database Reporting Specialist
Description:
The Montana State University Alumni Foundation is seeking an objective, detail-oriented Database Reporting Analyst to join our collaborative team in a flexible hybrid or remote role. In this position, you will be producing accurate, dependable data and meaningful insights that help strengthen lifelong relationships, support fundraising efforts, and advance the mission of Montana State University.

This opportunity is well suited for someone who values technical precision, thoughtful problem-solving, and the autonomy to improve processes and deliver trusted results. You will have the chance to apply your analytical expertise to work with a clear purpose, while contributing to a supportive team that values accuracy, sound judgment, continuous improvement, and the important role data plays in building relationships and inspiring private support.

Administrator: Director, Reporting & Analytics

Preferred Experience: 2+ years of experience in SQL programming and SQL Server databases; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Education Required: Baccalaureate Degree in computer science, computer engineering, information systems / technology, or related Degree with relevant experience.

Overtime Status: Exempt, not eligible for overtime

FTE and Benefits: 1.0 FTE, eligible for full employment benefits

Location: Remote or flexible hybrid schedule available.

Preferred Start Date: Sept 15, 2026

Major Duties And Responsibilities

The Database Reporting Analyst for the Montana State University Alumni Foundation (“Alumni Foundation”) is primarily responsible for fulfillment of targeted data and report requests from both external Montana State University (“University”) partners, and internal Alumni Foundation team members. The Database Reporting Analyst reports to the Director, Reporting & Analytics, Advancement Services Team.

Anticipated Distribution Of Time And Effort Are Outlined Below

30%

Manage and fulfill data and information requests from University partners and internal Alumni Foundation team members.

30%

Develop ad hoc and self-serve reports.

20%

Design/Maintain/Perform regular data extract, transform, and load operations (“ETL”) using SQL Server Integration Services (“SSIS”).

20%

Other duties including but not limited to: Business process development & SOPs Documentation. Assist in data hygiene and maintenance.

Specific Duties And Responsibilities


Assist with data and information requests (i.e. list requests) to external University partners and manage all request-related communications.
Assist with data and report requests by collaborating with other members of the Advancement Services team.
Provide quality assurance for reporting outputs by validating data accuracy, reviewing query logic, documenting assumptions, and ensuring appropriate handling of confidential constituent, donor, and institutional information.
Collaborate on reporting and integration-related work involving SQL Server, Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services, Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services, and other reporting or data tools used by the Alumni Foundation.
Develop, document, and disseminate targeted best practices and standard operating procedures (“SOP’s”) related to the fulfillment of targeted data and information requests from the Alumni Foundation database.
Support database management and data cleanup procedures by identifying data quality issues and recommending corrective actions.
Implement existing procedures and develop new SQL-based queries and procedures to fulfill targeted data requests, reporting needs, and data ETLs.
Utilize Visual Studio for various development tasks and integrating with SSRS projects.
Identify database-related improvement opportunities and collaborate with members of the Advancement Services team to develop and implement solutions.
Affect and maintain a professional, proactive, positive, highly collaborative, and performance-centric work environment.
Other duties, as assigned by the Director, Reporting & Analytics.


Duties and responsibilities may change at any time.

Special Skills And Qualifications


Understanding of and experience with the SQL Server query development and the Microsoft SQL Server/BI stack, including SSMS, Visual Studio Data Tools, SSRS, SSIS, complex joins, stored procedures, query validation, and performance considerations.
General programming and database administration experience helpful.
Experience developing documentation, SOPs, data definitions, reporting standards, and quality-control practices.
Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment while remaining helpful, pleasant, and courteous.
Complete respect for confidentiality and sound judgment in handling sensitive constituent, donor, institutional, and partner data.
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, analytical judgment, and commitment to data accuracy.
Experience developing and maintaining solutions using Microsoft Power Platform components (Power BI Desktop, Power Automate, and Power Apps) is a plus.


Benefits

The MSU Alumni Foundation offers a comprehensive benefit package which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance (all of which are 90-100% employer-paid for employee-only coverage), 403(b) retirement plan with 7% employer contribution after 1-yr anniversary, up to 5 weeks’ paid time-off, 11 paid holidays, tuition assistance and more.

Applications And Recruitment

Qualified candidates should submit a cover letter, a resume, and three professional references online. Recruitment will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. Compensation will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

The MSU Alumni Foundation is an equal employment opportunity employer who believes that diversity, equity and inclusion allow us to better serve our students and communities and are critical to supporting the mission of Montana State University as a land grant institution.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

The First Nations Tax Commission's is looking for a Data Analyst to help build and advance our Data and Statistics function. Reporting to the Director, Information & Technology, the Data Analyst helps transform data into meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making, demonstrate the impact of FNTC services, and strengthen the understanding of First Nation local revenues and economies.




Working closely with the Data Engineer, the Data Analyst develops reports, dashboards, and visualizations that enable evidence-informed decision-making across the organization. As the primary point of contact for staff, the Data Analyst helps ensure data is accessible, understood, and effectively used to support organizational priorities.




This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex programs, collaborating with others and continuously improving how data is used to support organizational priorities.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that support organizational planning, decision-making, and program evaluation.
Prepare, interpret, and communicate analytical findings through dashboards, reports, infographics, and other data visualizations.
Develop and maintain key performance indicators, performance measures, and reporting frameworks.
Translate technical and statistical information into meaningful business insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Respond to requests for information, reporting, and data analysis from across the organization.
Serve as the primary point of contact for staff requiring support with dashboards, reporting tools, and the Data and Statistics Function.
Collaborate with business areas to identify reporting needs, gather requirements, and recommend data-driven solutions.
Support user training and promote effective use of reporting tools and dashboards.
Develop and maintain documentation for reporting methodologies, business definitions, and analytical processes.
Partner with the Data Engineer to improve reporting capabilities, data quality, and analytical processes.
Support the development and continuous improvement of policies, procedures, and standards related to data collection, validation, management, and reporting.
Contribute to organizational information management, privacy, records management, and data governance practices.
Support compliance with ISO certification requirements and other applicable data standards and best practices.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve data accessibility, and enhance organizational reporting capabilities.
Contribute to projects that strengthen organizational research, evidence-informed decision-making, and continuous improvement.




WHAT YOU BRING

We're looking for a naturally curious professional who enjoys transforming data into meaningful insights. Someone who thrives on problem solving, collaborating with others, and continuously improving how data is collected, analyzed, and used to support better decision-making.




The successful candidate will likely bring:

A post-secondary education in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, or a related discipline—or an equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and experience.
Two (2) to three (3) experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or analytics, with the ability to analyze complex datasets and translate findings into meaningful business insights.
Experience developing dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools.
Understanding of data governance, data quality, information management, privacy legislation, and records management principles.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Databricks, SQL, or similar analytics platforms is considered an asset. Microsoft certifications in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Data Analytics, or related disciplines are considered assets.
Knowledge of artificial intelligence technologies and their application to analytics and business intelligence is considered an asset.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities from complex data.
The ability to communicate technical and statistical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Excellent organizational, project management, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong interpersonal, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with a collaborative approach to working across teams.
A commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies, analytics tools, and industry best practices.




WHY JOIN US? 

At the FNTC, you'll have the opportunity to build something meaningful. We offer:

A competitive total rewards package, including a comprehensive benefits plan and a 7% employer-matched retirement savings program.
Generous paid time off, including an annual winter office closure.
Observance of federal holidays, including paid recognition of National Indigenous Peoples Day
Ongoing learning and development opportunities that support your professional growth and career growth.
A collaborative, inclusive, and purpose-driven team environment committed to enabling healthy, vibrant and sustainable First Nation communities. 




We are an equal opportunity employer that values and celebrates the unique experiences and perspectives of First Nations peoples and individuals from diverse backgrounds across Canada. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and supported.




As a First Nations-led institution, we strongly encourage applications from individuals with lived or living experience as an Indigenous person.




Ready to apply?

Please submit a resume and cover letter as part of your application. Thank you in advance for your interest in this opportunity—please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted. 




ANALYSTE DE DONNÉES, SERVICES INTÉGRÉS




LA POSSIBILITÉ

La Commission de la fiscalité des premières nations est à la recherche d’un ou d’une analyste de données pour nous aider à établir et à faire progresser notre fonction de Données et statistiques. Relevant du directeur ou de la directrice, Information et technologie, l’analyste de données aide à transformer les données en informations utiles qui appuient la prise de décisions stratégiques, démontrent l’incidence des services de la CFPN et renforcent la compréhension des recettes et des économies des Premières Nations.




En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec l’ingénieur ou l’ingénieure de données, l’analyste de données élabore et communique des tableaux de bord et des visualisations qui permettent la prise de décisions éclairées par des données probantes à l’échelle de l’organisation. En tant que personne-ressource principale pour le personnel, l’analyste de données aide à veiller à ce que les données soient accessibles, comprises et utilisées de manière efficace pour soutenir les priorités organisationnelles.




Il s’agit d’une possibilité passionnante pour quelqu’un qui aime résoudre des programmes complexes, collaborer avec les autres et améliorer de façon continue la façon dont les données sont utilisées pour soutenir les priorités organisationnelles.

 

CE QUE VOUS APPORTEZ

Le candidat retenu ou la candidate retenue apportera probablement :

Des études postsecondaires en informatique, Sciences des données, Systèmes d’information, Analyse commerciale, Génie logiciel ou dans une discipline connexe—ou une combinaison équivalente d’études, de formation, de certifications et d’expérience;
De deux (2) à trois (3) ans d’expérience en analyse de données, informatique décisionnelle, production de rapports ou en analytique, de même que la capacité d’analyser des ensembles de données complexes et de traduire les résultats en perspectives d’affaires utiles;
De l’expérience dans l’élaboration de tableaux de bord, de rapports et de visualisations en utilisant Power BI ou des outils semblables d’informatique décisionnelle;
Une compréhension de la gouvernance des données, de la qualité des données, de la gestion de l’information, des lois sur la protection de la vie privée et des principes de gestion des documents;
De l’expérience avec Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Databricks, SQL ou des plateformes d’analyse semblables est considérée comme étant un atout. Des certifications Microsoft en Power BI, en Microsoft Fabric, en Azure, en analyse de données ou en d’autres disciplines connexes sont considérées comme des atouts;

Title: Analytics Developer
Description:
A Little Bit About Us

Founded in Vancouver in 2016, FORM is the sports technology company behind the award-winning FORM Smart Swim Goggles. Since launching in 2019, our goggles have earned global recognition, including Red Dot, iF Design, and Global Triathlon awards, and are trusted by professional athletes, age-group triathletes, and swimmers looking to get better.

We're a talented, tight-knit team that's fun to work with and serious about building great products. Together, we bring decades of consumer product experience spanning sports eyewear, interface design, and activity-tracking algorithms.

To learn more, visit formswim.com

Position Overview

We're seeking an experienced Analytics Developer to strengthen FORM's analytics data foundation and business intelligence capabilities. Working primarily in SQL, dbt, Amazon Redshift and Tableau, you will transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce and financial data into trusted, reusable models and translate those models into clear, decision-ready dashboards and visualizations. This is a hands-on role for someone who can contribute quickly, take ownership of production work and leave well-tested, documented systems and intuitive reporting behind.

Primary Responsibilities


Build and maintain scalable SQL and dbt models in Amazon Redshift
Transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce, marketing and financial data into clean, reusable analytics datasets
Define and maintain consistent business metrics, including revenue, MRR, churn, retention, trial conversion, customer lifetime value and sales performance
Implement automated data-quality tests, documentation and lineage so stakeholders can trust and understand the data
Monitor scheduled analytics workflows, investigate failures and improve pipeline reliability
Develop and maintain Tableau data sources and dashboards using curated warehouse models
Build Python-based data integrations and automation where SQL and dbt are not the right tools
Improve Git-based development, code review, deployment and CI/CD practices for analytics
Partner with Analytics, Data Engineering and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable data products


Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications


3 - 5 years of experience in analytics development, data engineering or a highly technical analytics role
Advanced SQL skills and strong knowledge of dimensional data modelling
Hands-on experience building, testing and documenting production data models with dbt
Experience working with a cloud data warehouse; Amazon Redshift and AWS experience are preferred
Experience using Git, code review and software development practices in an analytics environment
Working proficiency in Python for data pipelines, integrations or automation
Experience with Tableau or another modern business intelligence platform
Ability to troubleshoot data issues across source systems, transformation pipelines and downstream reporting
Strong communication skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into clear, maintainable data solutions


Nice to Haves


Experience with Dagster, Airflow or another workflow orchestration platform
Experience with Fivetran or other managed data ingestion tools
Experience with subscription, ecommerce, product telemetry or financial data
Experience working in a fast-paced startup or consumer technology environment


We thank you for your interest in FORM and to everyone who took the time to apply for this position, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.

FORM is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of diversity and inclusion. We recognize that we are better able to achieve our goals and live our core values when we have a diverse team of employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment. We welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, race, colour, place of origin, religion, family status, marital status, physical or mental disability, sex, age, sexual orientation, or political beliefs.

Benefits


Extended Healthcare Plan (Medical, Disability, Dental & Vision)
Group Life - AD&D - Critical Illness Insurance
Paid Time Off Benefits
Employee Discounts
Employee Assistance Program - Counselling


This role has an annual salary range of $90,000 to $110,000. Most new hires do not start at the top of the range. Compensation is determined based on a candidate's experience, skills, qualifications, and overall alignment with the role.

Candidates who are newer to this level of responsibility but demonstrate strong potential may receive an offer toward the lower end of the range. Offers at the higher end are typically reserved for candidates with extensive, directly relevant experience and a proven track record of success in comparable roles and environments.

Title: Research Analyst
Description:
CHAMINADE UNIVERSITY OF HONOLULU

MISSION STATEMENT

Chaminade University offers its students an education in a collaborative learning environment that prepares them for life, service and successful careers. Guided by its Catholic, Marianist and liberal arts educational traditions, Chaminade encourages the development of moral character, personal competencies, and a commitment to build a just and peaceful society. The University offers both the civic and church communities of the Pacific region its academic and intellectual resources in the pursuit of common aims.

I. Position Information

Title: Research Analyst

Division: Academic Affairs/Vice Provost

Department: Office of Institutional Research & Institutional Effectiveness

Exempt

Full Time

1.0 FTE

Staff

EAM/Grade: TBD by Human Resources

II. Position Summary

The Research Analyst is the primary technical and analytical staff role for the Office of Institutional Research & Institutional Effectiveness. The incumbent serves as the primary technical coordinator for assigned institutional research, institutional reporting, assessment-support, and compliance-reporting functions; produces and validates institutional reports; develops dashboards, one-pagers, census and post-census packages, and recurring data packets; supports required federal, state, accreditation, and other official reporting; and maintains the documentation, methodology notes, data dictionary, change log, and reporting repository needed to make institutional reporting repeatable, accurate, and dependable over time. The Research Analyst also supports a culture of evidence by helping institutional stakeholders understand what the data mean, what the limits of the data are, and how information should be interpreted for planning and improvement. The position may use institutionally approved AI-enabled tools to improve workflow efficiency, documentation, summarization, query support, data-cleaning processes, and draft reporting products while maintaining human review, data privacy, methodological transparency, and responsibility for validated institutional data.

III. Reports To

Direct Report to: Assistant Provost for Institutional Effectiveness

IV. Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Decision Support (25%)


Provides ad hoc analysis and decision-support for Cabinet, deans, chairs, program directors, committees, and accreditation work when requests align with office priorities and governance.
Supports request intake, triage, tracking, and prioritization for data and reporting requests, ensuring that requests are aligned with office priorities, data-governance expectations, and available capacity.
Translates technical findings into plain-language summaries, interpretation notes, dashboards, one-pagers, and other visual reporting products that are useful to non-technical audiences.
Supports a culture of evidence by helping units understand the meaning, appropriate use, limitations, and planning implications of institutional data.
Contributes to survey design, administration, reporting, environmental scans, benchmarking, and special studies as assigned.


Standard Reporting and Analytics (45%)


Produces and maintains recurring institutional reports and dashboards, including enrollment, census and post-census reporting, retention, graduation, student success, and other standard university metrics.
Develops and maintains program review data packets, fact book content, cabinet- and dean-level one-pagers, and other standard reporting products that reduce one-off work and improve consistency.
Supports assessment and academic program review reporting infrastructure, including WEAVE, assessment archives, program-review evidence packets, assessment documentation, and related reporting repositories as assigned.
Coordinates or supports the course/faculty evaluation survey process, including survey setup, data validation, summary reporting, documentation, and communication of results as assigned.
Supports grant-performance reporting and other externally funded project reporting by preparing validated data extracts, recurring performance summaries, and methodology documentation as assigned.
Rebuilds and improves high-use reports in the institution’s reporting environment so commonly requested information can be produced more accurately, more quickly, and with less reliance on manual workarounds.
Maintains a shared reporting repository, data dictionary, change log, documentation of systems and routines, and methodology notes so that reports can be understood, checked, and continued over time.
Conducts data quality review and validation in partnership with units such as the Registrar, Finance, Student Affairs, Academic Affairs, Information Technology, and Student Success.
Crafts reports and dashboards in PowerBI or similar reporting and visualization tools for use by operational units in the performance of their functional responsibilities.
Uses institutionally approved AI-assisted tools, when appropriate, to support documentation, report drafting, code or query review, survey-theme summaries, data-cleaning workflows, and workflow efficiency; verifies AI-assisted outputs before use in institutional reports, dashboards, or official submissions.


External Reporting and Compliance Support (30%)


Serves as the primary technical preparer and coordinator for assigned official reports, including IPEDS, Common Data Set, Financial Value Transparency/Gainful Employment, NSLDS student-level and program-level reporting, National Student Clearinghouse, state submissions, WSCUC/SARA-related reporting, accreditation data requests, and other required federal, state, accreditor, or institutional submissions as assigned.
Supports required external reporting by preparing data extracts, validating definitions, reconciling discrepancies, documenting methodology, and coordinating timelines for federal, state, accreditor, and other official submissions.
Coordinates with responsible offices on coding decisions, definitions, validation procedures, data-quality checks, interpretation notes, and repeatable workflows for high-stakes reporting.
Maintains the annual reporting calendar for assigned external and institutional reports, including timelines, definitions, data sources, responsible offices, validation steps, submission records, and methodology notes.
Documents assumptions, validation steps, limitations, and human-review procedures for AI-assisted analysis or reporting workflows when such tools are used.
Works with Information Technology, Data Governance, and the supervisor to ensure AI-enabled tools are used consistently with institutional policy, FERPA, data privacy, security expectations, and official-reporting standards.
Completes responses to surveys by publishers and other organizations when aligned with office priorities.
Performs other job-related duties as assigned.


V. Disclaimer

This list of responsibilities is not exhaustive. Details relating to both essential and non-essential functions of the job are not precise and are only an approximation, which can vary on a day-to-day basis and are subject to change on an as-needed basis and/or in the sole discretion of supervisory management.

VI. Education And Experience

Minimum


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as higher education, social science, statistics, public policy, data analytics, information systems, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience in institutional research, higher education reporting, data analysis, business intelligence, or another role involving complex data management and interpretation.
Demonstrated ability to work accurately with large datasets, apply definitions consistently, maintain documentation, and use strong quality assurance practices.


Preferred


Master’s degree in a relevant field.
Experience in higher education institutional research, assessment support, accreditation reporting, or decision-support work.
Experience with student information systems, enterprise reporting tools, business intelligence platforms, or relational databases used in higher education.
Experience supporting IPEDS, Common Data Set, National Student Clearinghouse, WSCUC/SARA-related reporting, Financial Value Transparency/Gainful Employment, or other federal, state, accreditation, compliance-related, or official reporting submissions.
Experience developing dashboards, methodology notes, data documentation, data dictionaries, and recurring institutional reports.
Experience with assessment management systems, survey platforms, program-review documentation, academic assessment reporting, or course/faculty evaluation reporting.
Experience supporting grant-performance reporting or externally funded project reporting.
Knowledge of enrollment, retention, graduation, financial aid, student success, and academic program data structures.
Familiarity with AI-assisted features in Microsoft 365, PowerBI, SQL/query environments, survey tools, documentation tools, or similar platforms.


VII. Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact and work with individuals at all levels of the University.
Ability to explain technical information clearly to faculty, academic leaders, operational units, and other non-technical users.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite or related software, with advanced skill in spreadsheets and data management tools.
Demonstrated skill in reporting tools, data visualization tools, and database or query environments appropriate to institutional reporting work.
Advanced skills in SQL and demonstrated experience working with relational databases. Familiarity with Ellucian Colleague, Slate, Canvas, PowerBI, or similar systems preferred.
Ability to manage data from disparate sources and reconcile differences across systems, definitions, timing, and reporting requirements.
Organized with meticulous attention to detail, thoroughness, documentation, and quality assurance.
Excellent project management skills and the ability to manage multiple recurring deadlines, prioritize work and resources, and maintain a predictable reporting calendar.
Broad experience in data reduction, analysis, documentation, interpretation, and presentation of research findings.
Ability to work collaboratively with offices such as the Registrar, Finance, Student Affairs, Academic Affairs, Information Technology, Student Success, and accreditation leaders.
Demonstrated AI literacy, including understanding of appropriate and inappropriate uses of generative AI in institutional research, reporting, documentation, and decision-support workflows.
Ability to use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly for productivity, documentation, summarization, and workflow support while protecting confidential student, employee, financial, and institutional data.
Ability to validate AI-generated summaries, code, formulas, visualizations, or analytic suggestions against source data, institutional definitions, and approved reporting methodology.
Understanding of privacy, confidentiality, FERPA-sensitive data handling, and institutional restrictions on entering protected or sensitive data into public or unapproved AI tools.


VIII. Physical Requirements

Duties involve light work in an office and community setting and require a minimum of physical effort with intermittent sitting, standing, climbing stairs, and walking inclines. Must be able to lift 20 pounds, walk the campus with ease, and have excellent motor skills. Must have finger dexterity. Must be able to communicate information and ideas so that others will understand.

IX. Other Requirements


This is a full-time, exempt, 1.0 FTE staff position. Forty hours per week (M-F) will be the general rule. However, depending on project cycles, external reporting deadlines, and workflow demands of the office, additional hours or workday schedule changes may occasionally be required. Must be willing and able to work occasional nights and weekends and a varying schedule.
Performs other related duties as assigned by Supervisor.
Observes all safety and health regulations and works in accordance with safe work procedures and policies of the University. Reports unsafe acts/conditions and injuries in a timely and proper manner.


X. Marianist Identity/Native Hawaiian & Pacific Island Serving

An expressed willingness to respect and support the Catholic and Marianist identity of Chaminade University of Honolulu and to perform all duties in a manner consistent with Marianist educational values and mission of the University. Understanding of and respect for the University’s designation as an institution that serves students of Native Hawaiian and Pacific Island ancestry.

 Decision Support (25%)

  • Provides ad hoc analysis and decision-support for Cabinet, deans, chairs, program directors, committees, and accreditation work when requests align with office priorities and governance.
  • Supports request intake, triage, tracking, and prioritization for data and reporting requests, ensuring that requests are aligned with office priorities, data-governance expectations, and available capacity.
  • Translates technical findings into plain-language summaries, interpretation notes, dashboards, one-pagers, and other visual reporting products that are useful to non-technical audiences.
  • Supports a culture of evidence by helping units understand the meaning, appropriate use, limitations, and planning implications of institutional data.
  • Contributes to survey design, administration, reporting, environmental scans, benchmarking, and special studies as assigned.

Standard Reporting and Analytics (45%)

  • Produces and maintains recurring institutional reports and dashboards, including enrollment, census and post-census reporting, retention, graduation, student success, and other standard university metrics.
  • Develops and maintains program review data packets, fact book content, cabinet- and dean-level one-pagers, and other standard reporting products that reduce one-off work and improve consistency.
  • Supports assessment and academic program review reporting infrastructure, including WEAVE, assessment archives, program-review evidence packets, assessment documentation, and related reporting repositories as assigned.
  • Coordinates or supports the course/faculty evaluation survey process, including survey setup, data validation, summary reporting, documentation, and communication of results as assigned.
  • Supports grant-performance reporting and other externally funded project reporting by preparing validated data extracts, recurring performance summaries, and methodology documentation as assigned.
  • Rebuilds and improves high-use reports in the institution’s reporting environment so commonly requested information can be produced more accurately, more quickly, and with less reliance on manual workarounds.
  • Maintains a shared reporting repository, data dictionary, change log, documentation of systems and routines, and methodology notes so that reports can be understood, checked, and continued over time.
  • Conducts data quality review and validation in partnership with units such as the Registrar, Finance, Student Affairs, Academic Affairs, Information Technology, and Student Success.
  • Crafts reports and dashboards in PowerBI or similar reporting and visualization tools for use by operational units in the performance of their functional responsibilities.
  • Uses institutionally approved AI-assisted tools, when appropriate, to support documentation, report drafting, code or query review, survey-theme summaries, data-cleaning workflows, and workflow efficiency; verifies AI-assisted outputs before use in institutional reports, dashboards, or official submissions.

External Reporting and Compliance Support (30%)

  • Serves as the primary technical preparer and coordinator for assigned official reports, including IPEDS, Common Data Set, Financial Value Transparency/Gainful Employment, NSLDS student-level and program-level reporting, National Student Clearinghouse, state submissions, WSCUC/SARA-related reporting, accreditation data requests, and other required federal, state, accreditor, or institutional submissions as assigned.
  • Supports required external reporting by preparing data extracts, validating definitions, reconciling discrepancies, documenting methodology, and coordinating timelines for federal, state, accreditor, and other official submissions.
  • Coordinates with responsible offices on coding decisions, definitions, validation procedures, data-quality checks, interpretation notes, and repeatable workflows for high-stakes reporting.
  • Maintains the annual reporting calendar for assigned external and institutional reports, including timelines, definitions, data sources, responsible offices, validation steps, submission records, and methodology notes.
  • Documents assumptions, validation steps, limitations, and human-review procedures for AI-assisted analysis or reporting workflows when such tools are used.
  • Works with Information Technology, Data Governance, and the supervisor to ensure AI-enabled tools are used consistently with institutional policy, FERPA, data privacy, security expectations, and official-reporting standards.
  • Completes responses to surveys by publishers and other organizations when aligned with office priorities.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

V. Disclaimer

This list of responsibilities is not exhaustive. Details relating to both essential and non-essential functions of the job are not precise and are only an approximation, which can vary on a day-to-day basis and are subject to change on an as-needed basis and/or in the sole discretion of supervisory management.

VI. Education And Experience

 Minimum

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as higher education, social science, statistics, public policy, data analytics, information systems, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience in institutional research, higher education reporting, data analysis, business intelligence, or another role involving complex data management and interpretation.
  • Demonstrated ability to work accurately with large datasets, apply definitions consistently, maintain documentation, and use strong quality assurance practices.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Experience in higher education institutional research, assessment support, accreditation reporting, or decision-support work.
  • Experience with student information systems, enterprise reporting tools, business intelligence platforms, or relational databases used in higher education.
  • Experience supporting IPEDS, Common Data Set, National Student Clearinghouse, WSCUC/SARA-related reporting, Financial Value Transparency/Gainful Employment, or other federal, state, accreditation, compliance-related, or official reporting submissions.
  • Experience developing dashboards, methodology notes, data documentation, data dictionaries, and recurring institutional reports.
  • Experience with assessment management systems, survey platforms, program-review documentation, academic assessment reporting, or course/faculty evaluation reporting.
  • Experience supporting grant-performance reporting or externally funded project reporting.
  • Knowledge of enrollment, retention, graduation, financial aid, student success, and academic program data structures.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted features in Microsoft 365, PowerBI, SQL/query environments, survey tools, documentation tools, or similar platforms.

VII. Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact and work with individuals at all levels of the University.
  • Ability to explain technical information clearly to faculty, academic leaders, operational units, and other non-technical users.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite or related software, with advanced skill in spreadsheets and data management tools.
  • Demonstrated skill in reporting tools, data visualization tools, and database or query environments appropriate to institutional reporting work.
  • Advanced skills in SQL and demonstrated experience working with relational databases. Familiarity with Ellucian Colleague, Slate, Canvas, PowerBI, or similar systems preferred.
  • Ability to manage data from disparate sources and reconcile differences across systems, definitions, timing, and reporting requirements.
  • Organized with meticulous attention to detail, thoroughness, documentation, and quality assurance.
  • Excellent project management skills and the ability to manage multiple recurring deadlines, prioritize work and resources, and maintain a predictable reporting calendar.
  • Broad experience in data reduction, analysis, documentation, interpretation, and presentation of research findings.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with offices such as the Registrar, Finance, Student Affairs, Academic Affairs, Information Technology, Student Success, and accreditation leaders.
  • Demonstrated AI literacy, including understanding of appropriate and inappropriate uses of generative AI in institutional research, reporting, documentation, and decision-support workflows.
  • Ability to use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly for productivity, documentation, summarization, and workflow support while protecting confidential student, employee, financial, and institutional data.
  • Ability to validate AI-generated summaries, code, formulas, visualizations, or analytic suggestions against source data, institutional definitions, and approved reporting methodology.
  • Understanding of privacy, confidentiality, FERPA-sensitive data handling, and institutional restrictions on entering protected or sensitive data into public or unapproved AI tools.

VIII. Physical Requirements

Duties involve light work in an office and community setting and require a minimum of physical effort with intermittent sitting, standing, climbing stairs, and walking inclines. Must be able to lift 20 pounds, walk the campus with ease, and have excellent motor skills. Must have finger dexterity. Must be able to communicate information and ideas so that others will understand.

IX. Other Requirements

  • This is a full-time, exempt, 1.0 FTE staff position. Forty hours per week (M-F) will be the general rule. However, depending on project cycles, external reporting deadlines, and workflow demands of the office, additional hours or workday schedule changes may occasionally be required. Must be willing and able to work occasional nights and weekends and a varying schedule.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned by Supervisor.
  • Observes all safety and health regulations and works in accordance with safe work procedures and policies of the University. Reports unsafe acts/conditions and injuries in a timely and proper manner.

X. Marianist Identity/Native Hawaiian & Pacific Island Serving

An expressed willingness to respect and support the Catholic and Marianist identity of Chaminade University of Honolulu and to perform all duties in a manner consistent with Marianist educational values and mission of the University. Understanding of and respect for the University’s designation as an institution that serves students of Native Hawaiian and Pacific Island ancestry.

Title: Data Engineer- Analytics

As a respected specialty insurer with 11 branch offices across 10 states, OR Bitco delivers tailored insurance solutions to complex industries such as construction, forest products, and oil and gas.

This position is open to hybrid work arrangement, blending flexibility with meaningful in-person collaboration.

At OR Bitco, our work is guided by core values. We care deeply about our people, partners, and customers. We are committed to excellence and accountability. We deliver on our promises with integrity and precision, and we strive to make a meaningful impact in everything we do. These values drive our mission to protect the people and industries that keep America running.

Join the OR Bitco team and be part of a workplace built on collaboration, open communication, and a positive culture that supports growth and success. If you are passionate about operational excellence and ready to make a measurable impact within a growing, industry-leading organization, OR Bitco offers the platform and challenge you have been seeking.

In this role, you’ll play a key role in building and maturing the Company's Data Services across all aspects of the organization. This includes recommending and implementing tools for enabling internal business units to leverage data securely, effectively, and efficiently.

You’ll develop high-level data analysis, participating in all stages of development from analysis to production releases, delivering data-driven insights to internal business customers. This is a highly collaborative role focusing on Data Services customer needs through data storytelling and insights while modernizing the analytics role for OR Bitco in a cloud-based environment.

You will be involved in all aspects of data science, engineering, and analytics as the Company instills and matures these capabilities and data discipline throughout the organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Collaborate with Project Managers, Business Leaders, Analysts, and other stakeholders to understand the analysis required in order to form data requirements and develop solutions that meet those needs while accommodating scalable volumes of data
Participate in strategic data and analytics projects to enable our business leaders to consume data in a curated self-service model that leads to impactful insights for key business areas
Integrate and deliver data-driven insights and analysis from multiple sources for internal customers to make decisions relevant to their functional area or across product, program, customer, and risk axis
Develop analysis frameworks to enable agile and quick data insights, while maintaining the quality of the insight, and inform strategy
Partner across all operational and support functions to build scalable data-based solutions that provide insights into improving key metrics/OKRs
Work with business leaders to understand market drivers, OKRs, and products to interpret data and make them comprehensible to understand for other teams
Experience with trend analysis and reviews, drafting executive outlines, and recommending strategic changes based on data insights to non-technical leadership teams
Understanding and Experience in Statistical Modeling, Natural Language Processing, GenAI, AIML modeling
Implement automated data quality checks and validation processes to ensure data integrity and accuracy at scale
Design, build, and maintain robust reporting packages from multiple sources through our data warehouse and analytics marts, ensuring scalability and efficiency
Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of our reporting and analysis system performance and optimize as needed to handle increasing data volumes
Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and reliability across multiple environments (warehouse, data marts, reporting)
Utilize Power BI to create insightful reports, dashboards, and visualizations to provide actionable insights to stakeholders
Troubleshoot data-related issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions in a timely manner to minimize business impact
Create and maintain design documents and documentation for reporting pipelines, semantic models, and processes Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in reporting and data analysis, recommending and implementing improvements as necessary to support scalability and growth
Work closely with various business units and leaders to identify and interpret their data needs, suggesting innovative ways to consume and analyze data
Create reusable templates, such as Power BI semantic models, to empower other data services and IT personnel in their reporting efforts
All other functions and duties as assigned


Qualifications


Legally authorized to work in the United States
3+ years of proven experience as a Data Analyst or similar reporting role, with a strong background in data analysis, reporting and statistics
Proven work experience with a focus on data storytelling, report development and in-depth data analysis
Solid understanding of data reporting models and communication
Proficiency in Power BI or similar reporting tools, SQL, and experience working with relational databases
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and tools, such as Snowflake or Microsoft Synapse
Experience with data modeling, semantic model design, and optimization techniques for scalability
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex data issues
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment
Self-motivated and proactive, with a passion for continuous learning and professional development


Benefits


Competitive salary paired with a comprehensive benefits package
Generous paid time off, plus 12 paid holidays annually
Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, dental, and vision plans
Additional protection through accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance
Company-paid life insurance equal to 2× annual salary
Company-paid short-term and long-term disability coverage
401(k) Savings and Profit-Sharing Plan through Old Republic
Ongoing education, training, and professional development opportunities
Support for industry certifications and insurance designations, including financial assistance
Opportunities to give back through corporate philanthropy and community service initiatives
Optional benefits including travel, commuter, and pet insurance
Employee wellness support through a dedicated fitness program

Title: Data Services Analyst
Description:
The Data Services Analyst delivers custom data solutions that help DMSi customers maximize the value from their ERP solution. This role works across a broad and growing set of technologies, including custom reporting, business intelligence dashboards, data transformations, and system integrations. The right candidate is execution-focused, intellectually curious, and eager to grow alongside an expanding technology stack. They will bring a strong aptitude for problem-solving, a collaborative mindset, and a genuine interest in using AI tools to work smarter and help the team build more efficient workflows.




RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

Evaluate and manage customer requests using internal systems, including the ability to scope, quote, design a solution, and execute on the project plan.
Develop and deliver custom data solutions, including report writing, data extractions, forms customization, business intelligence dashboards, and system integrations.
Use AI tools and assistants as a standard part of daily work to increase efficiency and contribute to the team’s development of AI-assisted workflows and internal tooling
Build proficiency in DMSi’s evolving product and integration ecosystem, including current and emerging platforms.
Develop and maintain an advanced working knowledge of DMSi’s internal support tools and delivery processes.
Assist other DMSi personnel through escalation support, coaching, and training on data-related topics.
Complete documentation related to job responsibilities and contribute to the DMSi Knowledge Base.
Lead, attend, or assist with training for internal personnel, customers, and prospects.
Assist with internal projects to support departmental and organizational objectives.




KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

Technical: SQL/query proficiency (Cyberquery a plus), BI tools (Power BI, Phocas, Tableau, etc.), ETL/data lineage and database fundamentals (schemas, indexes, keys).

Analytical: Genuine curiosity paired with strong problem-solving, research, and the ability to work independently through ambiguous business challenges.

AI-forward: Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, Copilot) to speed up and improve work quality.

Quality-focused: High attention to detail, diagnoses issues correctly and validates solutions before customers see them.

Technical collaboration: Familiar with integration/automation (Workato or similar), comfortable with code reviews and tools like GitHub.

Execution: Prioritizes well, works under pressure, hits deadlines.

People skills: Communicates clearly, builds relationships across all levels (including customers/vendors), exercises tact and keeps confidentiality.




EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

College degree in Data Science, Computer Information Systems (CIS), Management Information Systems (MIS), Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related discipline preferred; 3-5 years of equivalent work experience in a relevant field will be considered.




WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Normal office environment with use of computers and telephone systems; no unusual physical demands.

Travel as needed, including business air travel and car rental.

Equal Opportunity Employer
