Title: Strategic Assessment Analyst (AI & Data Systems)
Description:
Amentum is seeking a Strategic Assessment Analyst (AI & Data Systems) to provide operational planning, data integration, research, and analysis support to the US PACOM J5 Strategy Branch. This position serves as a critical member of the J5 Assessment Team, acting as the hub for assessment efforts among the directorates and our components.

The Strategic Assessment Analyst will support the J5 Strategy Branch by leveraging artificial intelligence, quantitative data modeling, and qualitative analysis to assess operational plans, programs, and strategic policies.

Primary Roles and Responsibilities:


Design, implement, and utilize Maven Smart System tools and agents to streamline and enhance operational and strategic assessment workflows.
Provide process methodology and analysis to execute comprehensive assessment functions, merging both quantitative and qualitative methodologies.
Engineer and maintain cross-domain data processes, ensuring that disparate data sources from various directorates and components are ingested, fused, and analyzed effectively.
Provide robust Knowledge Management solutions in the context of AI models, tools, and agents—specifically focusing on Maven Smart Systems—to ensure assessment data is accessible, reliable, and actionable.
Construct and deliver analytical products for use by the PACOM Commander and other senior leaders.
Develop automated dashboards, briefing documents, and decision papers on various topics to support senior leadership decision-making regarding recent, ongoing, or anticipated military activities.
Assist with the production and implementation of long-term, fully integrated Department of War (DoW) strategies by applying innovative AI approaches to campaign and contingency plan assessments.


Minimum Requirements:


Bachelor’s degree in data science, Operations Research, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Applied Economics, National Security Studies, or related field.
Familiarity with military assessment processes, demonstrating proficiency in both quantitative and qualitative assessment design.
Proven ability to design, deploy, and use Maven Smart System tools and agents in a secure environment.
Demonstrated ability to use AI capabilities (e.g., large language models, machine learning algorithms, automated agents) to execute complex assessment functions.
Experience in engineering cross-domain data processes, with an understanding of data pipelines, architecture, and secure knowledge management principles.
At least 5 years’ experience working in military operations, either on an operations staff, in strategic planning, or within an intelligence/data fusion role.
Demonstrate excellent written and oral communications, with the ability to translate complex AI/data-centric findings into digestible strategic military advice.
Must have an active Top-Secret clearance, with TS/SCI eligibility later during employment. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain Top-Secret Clearance.
This position may require a polygraph after employment.


Preferred Qualiﬁcations:


Master’s degree in operations research, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.
At least 3 years’ experience on a senior military staff (Service HQ, Major Command, Office of the Secretary of Defense, or the Joint Staff) specifically working within the Joint Planning Process (JPP).
Advanced proficiency in programming languages commonly used in data analysis and AI (e.g., Python, R, SQL).
Previous experience supporting a J5 Directorate or military strategy branch.

Associate III - Data Engineering

Who We Are

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven group of 29,000+ practical problem solvers and creative thinkers in more than 30 countries. Our entrepreneurial teams are empowered to innovate, act nimbly, and create a lasting and sustainable impact for our clients, their customers, and the communities in which we live.

With us, you’ll create a boundless impact that transforms your career—and the lives of people across the world.

Visit us at UST.com.

You Are

UST is seeking a product-oriented Data Analyst to design, analyze, and operationalize data objects, data quality rules, and analytics frameworks that drive pricing, search, and operational performance at scale.

The Opportunity


Analyze, document, and design data objects, dimensional models, and data quality rules for analytics and reporting use cases.
Ensure governance, compliance, documentation, and explainability across all data assets and analyses
Monitor and analyze key KPIs across business including established SLAs
Run Pricing and Search frameworks
Diagnose pricing vs. search vs. supply related performance issues through structured, hypothesis driven deep dive analysis.
Produce insights that inform operational levels, readiness for large sales events, and configuration changes.


This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

Experience range: 4-6 years of experience

Proven ability to work effectively both independently and in cross functional teams.
Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong customer focus with a high bar for quality and accuracy.
Ability to thrive in a fast paced, agile development environment.

Compensation Range: $62,000-$93,000

Benefits

Full-time, regular employees accrue a minimum of 10 days of paid vacation per year, receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year), 10 paid holidays, and are eligible for paid bereavement leave and jury duty. Benefits offerings vary in Puerto Rico.

They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Title: Data Analyst, ReBIRD
Description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:
As the Data Analyst, ReBIRD, your expertise in analysis and data-driven insights supports key decisions on product service, repair, and long-term strategy. Reporting to the Senior Data Analyst, ReBIRD you will work closely with cross-functional partners of the ReBIRD program to deliver a best-in-class guest experience that extends the lifecycle of Arc’teryx products. You are a driven professional focused on creating a data-driven culture and enabling decision makers in the short- and long-term strategy to deliver on a best-in-class guest experience.




This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.






Meet Your Future Team:




Under the Circularity umbrella, the ReBIRD team supports the operations of our warranty and repairs program, our service centers within retail, and resale.  The global ReBIRD program focuses on an exceptional Guest experience at all Commercial touchpoints, inclusive of Guest Services, After Sales, Branded activations, and especially within our owned Vertical channels, Retail and eCommerce. 







If you were in the Data Analyst, ReBIRD role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:


Performing data manipulation and analysis to support key performance metrics across the service and repair network


Maintaining recurring forecasts and supporting the development of new forecasting techniques


Building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI including troubleshooting and debugging errors, refreshing, and publishing data


Gathering business requirements and translating them into data requirements and specifications


Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Business Intelligence, Technology, Design, Quality Control, and Supply Chain; representing company needs in after-sales returns and service and working on projects to enable informed decision making


Improving data through research and analysis of product returns and trends in support of product insights and design teams


Understanding and teaching others about global service delivery systems and processes in relation to regional differences and constraints for reporting visibility





Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:





Supporting the creation and reporting of sustainability metrics and measuring the impact of the service and repair program, in partnership with our Sustainability team


Contributing to the evolution of data tools across the business, providing subject matter expertise in future development of data platforms


Integrating APAC regions into greater data analytics work to better inform global ReBIRD analytics


Incorporating raw material data to support forecasting, ordering, managing, and fulfillment






Are you our next Data Analyst, ReBIRD?



You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Business or a related field


You have 3+ years' experience synthesizing complex analysis into actionable insights and presenting insights to senior leaders


You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to summarize and express ideas clearly through visualizations, written documents and presentations


You have extensive experience in data visualization and analysis software (e.g. Power BI, Excel, Tableau, SQL, etc.)


You have experience with data manipulation and management including ETL, user provisioning, and Power BI service management


You have experience balancing customer focus with long-term strategic goals and operational constraints, and you take initiative in documenting and presenting opportunities for improvement


You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions.


You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity.


Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it.


You are able and willing to travel as required








CompensationThe salary range for this role is CAD$71,000 - CAD$93,000
















Total Rewards




Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility. 










We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team. 










In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life: 












Health & wellbeing - Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).


Financial wellbeing - RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.

Title: Technical Data Package Analyst
Description:
Location: Halifax - Wilkinson, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Technical Data Package Analyst

Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements


This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level



Key Areas of Responsibility


Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems.
Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests.
Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data.
Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments.
Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records.
Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements.



Chorus Role


Prepare and Deliver Customer Service



Minimum Qualifications


Technical System Expertise: Proven experience using both Maximo and DRMIS (or CGCS/CGCM) is mandatory.
Software Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills are essential (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, and complex data reconciliation).
Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA.
Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment.
Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently.



If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Preferred Qualifications


Data Analytics & Database Tools: Proficiency in Power BI and Microsoft Access is considered a strong asset.
Defense & In-Service Support Experience: Experience with DND In-Service Support (ISS) contracts and experience supporting an operational military asset.
Logistics Support Analysis Expertise: Familiarity with Logistics Support Analysis (LSA) and exposure to Logistics Support Analysis application software such as OmegaPS.
Technical Publications & Documentation Standards: Knowledge of Canadian Forces Technical Orders (CFTOs) and government-adopted technical publications.
Digital Technical Data Standards: Knowledge of the S1000D specification and Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) format.
Language Requirements: Bilingualism (English/French).



Special Position Requirements


Schedule: Core business hours Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week.
Physical Environment: Hybrid position – which is a mix of working from home and onsite (in office, at customer site or on-board ships alongside in harbour.
Physical Demands: Predominantly office work but may be required to work in dockyards and onboard Naval ships.
Travel: Occasional domestic travel maybe required in support of the ships.



What We Offer

The reference Total Target Compensation (TTC) market range for this position, inclusive of annual base salary and the variable compensation target, is between Total Target Cash (TTC) $74,146.88– $126,733.63 CAD Annual. This reflects how companies in a similar industry and geographic region generally pay for similar jobs. This range helps the Company make pay decisions as one data point among many. Where a position falls within this range is also dependent on other factors including – but not limited to – the employee’s career path history, competencies, skills and performance, as well as the company’s annual salary budget, the customer’s program requirements, and the company’s internal equity. Description:
Welcome Home!

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation.




Build Trusted Data. Empower Every Decision.

As the Analytics Data Specialist, you will champion and deliver enterprise data products that turn raw data into trusted insights, enabling scalable analytics through an Analytics Centre of Excellence. As part of the team that powers enterprise reporting and decision-making, you'll empower every area of the business with trusted data and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. Led by the Manager, Data and Analytics, this opportunity suits a collaborative and detail-oriented professional who enjoys building scalable data solutions, enabling enterprise analytics, and solving complex data challenges.




Ready to make an impact in a new role? Here’s how:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data products within Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystems that deliver trusted, business-ready data for reporting, analytics and decision making.
Develop and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse data architectures, ensuring structured high performing data layers that support enterprise analytics.
Design and optimize business aligned semantic models that enable consistent reporting and analytics.
Develop automated data pipelines and integrated workflows using Fabric Data Factory, notebooks and Azure services to transform and deliver data.
Implement scalable data transformations that standardize how data is curated and modeled for analytics consumption.
Ensure data quality, integrity and reliability through validation, monitoring and cleansing processes across all datasets.
Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver high quality data solutions and enable adoption of enterprise data products.
Support enterprise data governance and master data management practices by applying data standards and lineage tracking.




We’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field; additional analytics certifications are an asset.
A minimum of five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a related analytics role.
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Strong experience with data engineering and analytics languages (PySpark, SQL, Python, R).
Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Azure SQL), PowerShell scripting, and ETL/ELT processes (SSIS).
Experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Experience with automation and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub) to support repeatable deployments.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional and semantic data models, and data governance practices.
Experience delivering end-to-end analytics solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and reporting (Power BI).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed data platforms.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently interact with senior leaders.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Highly adaptable, with a passion for learning and evolving alongside emerging technologies such as Microsoft Fabric and AI.
Experience with data mining, predictive analytics, machine learning, and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) is an asset.
The ability to be onsite three days a week at our corporate office in St. Jacobs, to accommodate our hybrid working model.

The expected starting salary range for this role is $85,800 - $128,600; the final offer will reflect relevant skills and experience.
Eligible for the annual bonus program.

Health, Dental, Vision, Paramedical, Disability coverage, Out of Country Travel Insurance, Life Insurance, Employee Family Assistance Program.

Group RRSP.

Home & Auto Insurance discounts.

Personal and sick time.

Financial Data Analyst supports financial planning, reporting, costing, and business decision-making through advanced data analysis and financial modeling. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Excel, Power BI, and database querying tools, combined with a solid foundation in accounting and ERP systems. Financial Analysis & Reporting

Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes.

Financial Modeling


Build, maintain, and enhance financial models for budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.
Develop profitability, pricing, and cost allocation models.
Perform sensitivity and trend analyses to support business initiatives and investments.


Business Intelligence & Data Analytics


Design and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI.

Improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and automation across finance processes.

Costing & ERP Systems

Maintain and validate financial data within ERP systems.

Accounting & Financial Controls


Apply general accounting principles to ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting.
Support month-end and year-end financial reporting activities.
Assist with account reconciliations, financial audits, and internal controls as required.
Ensure data integrity between ERP systems and reporting platforms.


Core Skills


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including: PivotTables, Power Query, Advanced formulas and functions, and Financial modeling
Strong proficiency in Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience writing and optimizing SQL queries and working with relational databases.
Strong understanding of data management, reporting automation, and analytics best practices.
Familiarity with ERP reporting tools and financial data structures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to translate complex financial data into clear business insights.
Effective communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Education


University degree in Business, Accounting or equivalent
CPA designation is not required.


Experience


3–7 years of experience in financial analysis, business analysis, data analytics, or related finance roles.
Experience building robust financial models and conducting financial analysis.
Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, JD Edwards, or similar).
Experience with costing and general accounting practices.
Experience in manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, or operational finance environments.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and business intelligence tools.
Experience with advanced analytics, forecasting, and scenario planning.
Understanding of cost accounting methodologies and profitability analysis.


Reasons To Apply


Employee retention and engagement is important to Cascade; we value our employees.
Comprehensive benefits package provided. Extended benefits and the Employee Resilience Program (all 100% paid by Cascade) are offered after 3 months of employment and Pension matching after 6 months.
ATO (Approved Training Organization) provides endorsement (type) training & development.
Company-wide social events and family functions throughout the year.
Relocation Package available for qualifying candidates.

Title: Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst
Description:
Location: Halifax - Wilkinson, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst

Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements


This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level



Key Areas of Responsibility


Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems.
Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests.
Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data.
Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments.
Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records.
Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements.



Chorus Role


Prepare and Deliver Customer Service



Minimum Qualifications


Technical System Expertise: Proven experience using both Maximo and DRMIS (or CGCS/CGCM) is mandatory.
Software Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills are essential (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, and complex data reconciliation).
Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA.
Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment.
Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently.



If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Preferred Qualifications

Title: Analyst, Offer Management & Optimization
Description:
This position requires in-person collaboration up to five days a week. This arrangement is subject to change based on business requirements.

Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. We’re proud to be one of Canada’s most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

Overview Of Role

As the Analyst, Offer Management & Optimization, you will tackle the complex puzzle of airline pricing by bringing WestJet's Offer Management strategy to life through data-driven execution. This role is focused on actively optimizing fares, designing dynamic bundles, and leveraging large datasets to test and deploy modern offer strategies.

Acting as a critical bridge between Commercial and Technology teams, working alongside Pricing, Revenue Management, Digital, Distribution, and external technology partners, you will ensure WestJet delivers innovative retailing capabilities that directly boost revenue and elevate guest value.

Key Responsibilities

Offer Execution & Optimization


Support the evolution and daily execution of WestJet's Offer Management capabilities across:
Fare price optimization
Ancillary price optimization
Dynamic bundle generation
Offer optimization and decisioning
Commercial experimentation and testing
Offer governance and configuration
Collaborate closely with Pricing and Revenue Management teams to ensure pricing strategies are effectively executed through Offer Management tools.


Cross-Functional Delivery


Manage day-to-day technical workflows with internal teams and external vendors, using tools like Postman to validate API requests, troubleshoot integrations, and ensure seamless offer delivery.
Participate in the business delivery of new capabilities by working with stakeholders across the organization including Pricing, Revenue Management, Distribution, Digital, Commercial Technology, Finance, and the Contact Centre.
Gather and document business requirements, coordinate testing, and assist with change management and release readiness to ensure successful implementations


Performance Management


Monitor product performance, build queries, and identify optimization opportunities by tracking key commercial metrics, including:
Revenue uplift
Conversion rates
Ancillary attachment
Bundle performance
Pricing effectiveness
Customer adoption
Provide regular reporting, dashboards, and actionable recommendations to leadership


Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
2–4 years of experience in data analytics, airline commercial strategy, pricing, revenue management, product management, or distribution
Experience supporting complex technology or commercial transformation initiatives
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and external vendors
Understanding of airline pricing and revenue management principles
Familiarity with Offer Management and Pricing Optimization concepts
Knowledge of airline retailing and distribution
Strong commercial and analytical mindset with proficiency in analyzing performance data
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights
Strong hands-on experience querying large relational databases using SQL on cloud platforms like Snowflake, and visualizing data in tools like Tableau or PowerBI
Familiarity with API testing and validation (e.g., using Postman) to support technical troubleshooting and vendor integrations is an asset


The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:


A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs


Think we’re a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. We’re Canada’s leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet's Alcohol and Drug Policy. 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply – even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.

We value the time and effort you put into your application. Our recruitment process is highly competitive and while every applicant will receive communication regarding their application status, only those selected to move forward will be contacted with next steps. If this role isn’t the right fit, we encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.

Title: Power BI Developer
Description:
About The Role

Job Overview:

As a Power BI Developer, you will play a dual role—developing impactful business intelligence solutions while also building strong relationships with potential clients. You will design, develop, and maintain business analytics dashboards and reports using Power BI to provide actionable insights for clients. Additionally, you will help explain the value of Power BI and other technology solutions to prospective clients, ensuring they understand how our offerings can solve their business challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement: Establish and maintain relationships with clients, understanding their data analytics needs and offering customized BI solutions.

Solution Development: Design, create, and manage Power BI reports and dashboards that transform raw data into meaningful insights.

Data Analysis: Work with clients to analyze business data, identify trends, and provide solutions that improve business performance.

Requirement Gathering: Collaborate with clients to understand their needs and translate them into effective Power BI solutions.

Technical Expertise: Advise clients on the best Power BI practices, data modeling, DAX expressions, and report optimization.

Sales Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to present Power BI solutions to prospective clients, demonstrating the value of data-driven decision-making.

Continuous Improvement: Stay up-to-date with Power BI features, and incorporate new tools and methodologies to improve client solutions.

Training: Provide client training sessions and documentation to ensure users can efficiently navigate and use Power BI tools.

Lead Generation Support: Assist in generating leads through strategic conversations and presentations that highlight our BI solutions.

Requirements

Qualifications:


Proven experience (3+ years) working as a Power BI Developer or Business Intelligence Specialist.
Strong technical skills in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX (Data Analysis Expressions), Power Query, and visualization best practices.
Experience with data integration from multiple data sources like SQL, Excel, and cloud-based databases.
Strong understanding of database management and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes.
Proven ability to understand client business challenges and develop technical solutions that address these issues.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple projects and client relationships simultaneously.
Familiarity with business process analysis and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.

Title: Decision Support Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 46744

Organization

Vancouver is consistently ranked as one of the world’s most liveable and environmentally sustainable cities. Recognized among BC’s Top Employers and Canada’s Greenest Employers, the City of Vancouver is seeking colleagues who can help advance our core commitments to exceptional public service, sustainability, equity, and an outstanding quality of life for all residents.

With a strong commitment to being a City of Reconciliation, we invite you to join our dedicated team and become part of an innovative, inclusive, and engaging workplace. A career with the City of Vancouver and within the broader public service, offers meaningful work where you play a key role in ensuring equitable access to services, upholding ethical governance, and supporting the needs of citizens with integrity and dedication.

Main Purpose and Function

The Decision Support Analyst is part of the City’s Centre of Expertise for Performance Measurement and Decision Support, within the Strategy and Project Support Office (SPSO). The role supports evidence-informed decision-making across the City by helping leaders understand service performance, assess options, evaluate outcomes, and identify opportunities to improve accountability, transparency and value for money.

The role combines performance measurement, service evaluation, business analysis and business intelligence to help leaders make sound strategic, operational and service-delivery decisions. A core part of the team’s mandate is enabling the delivery of an enterprise-wide corporate planning process and the evaluation of City services, ensuring decisions are grounded in consistent, comparable evidence.

The analysis considers operational, financial, resource and service-delivery implications and supports recommendations to managers and senior leaders.

The Decision Support Analyst partners closely with corporate and departmental teams to build a culture of data-informed decision-making across the City. This includes increasing data literacy, enabling data exploration, supporting adoption of business intelligence tools, and translating complex analysis into clear, decision-ready insight.

Specific Duties/Responsibilities


Performance Measurement and Corporate Planning
Supports performance measurement reporting by linking City services and service plans to performance metrics, departmental work plans and the corporate plan.
Supports the design and delivery of the City’s enterprise-wide corporate planning process, helping connect service plans, performance measures and corporate priorities.
Supports corporate, capital and service-planning processes by connecting service plans and performance information to operating requirements, costs and resource implications.
Develops, monitors and analyzes performance metrics and benchmarks to assess the efficiency, effectiveness and outcomes of City services.
Helps identify short-term and long-term measures that support continuous improvement, service planning and corporate accountability.
Reviews and analyzes how major City decisions may affect service plans, performance measures and service-delivery outcomes.


Service Evaluation and Decision Support


Contributes to the evaluation of City services by helping define evaluation questions, identify measures of success, gather evidence, analyze outcomes and summarize findings.
Synthesizes quantitative and qualitative evidence into clear findings, implications and options for decision-makers.
Provides analytical decision support, including business analysis, options analysis, scenario modelling and business case development, and develops findings and recommendations for managers and senior leaders.
Analyzes and develops service proposals and business cases, including their operating, financial, resource, risk, benefit and performance implications.
Assists client departments in identifying opportunities to improve service outcomes, strengthen accountability, increase transparency and support value-for-money decision-making.
Applies structured problem-solving approaches to complex business, operational and service-delivery questions.


Analytics, Reporting and Data Quality


Develops and maintains datasets, reports, dashboards and analytical models using tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL and other business intelligence platforms.
Supports the development of user-friendly reporting products that help leaders and service owners understand performance, trends, risks and opportunities.
Works with client departments to identify and remediate data quality issues that affect reporting, analysis and decision-making.
Supports the team’s use of modern analytics platforms, including Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or similar tools, as required.
Contributes to the development of consistent reporting methods, data definitions and analytical approaches across the City.


Stakeholder Support and BI Adoption


Works with client departments to understand business needs, clarify decision questions and translate those needs into useful analytical products.
Supports adoption of business intelligence tools by developing guidance materials, providing training or coaching, and helping users interpret and apply performance information.
Builds effective working relationships with technical, professional and operational staff across the City.
Presents analysis clearly and appropriately for different audiences, including operational teams, managers and senior leaders.
Supports a culture of data-informed decision-making by helping departments use evidence to understand performance, improve services and make better decisions.
Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualification Requirements

Education and Experience:


A relevant master’s degree, such as Business Analytics, Commerce, Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, Public Administration or an MBA, or a professional designation, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience. Examples include a CPA.
Minimum 4–5 years of experience in performance measurement, data analytics, service or program evaluation, business analysis, business intelligence or a related field, ideally in a large, complex organization.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Considerable knowledge of performance metrics, benchmarking and service evaluation, with the ability to link operational and financial measures to service outcomes.
Considerable knowledge of business intelligence, analytics and automation tools to transform data into reliable, user-friendly reporting and decision-support products.
Considerable knowledge of business intelligence and analytics tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL and data modelling approaches.
Considerable knowledge of designing performance measures, indicators or evaluation approaches that inform strategic, operational or service-delivery decisions.
Ability to support corporate planning, service planning, business planning or enterprise reporting processes.
Ability to systematically frame and breakdown complex issues, opportunities or service questions, and reaches conclusions supported by evidence and sound judgment.

Title: Portfolio Analyst
Description:
Detailed Job Description

Join us in enabling trade through Canada's largest port

The Vancouver Fraser Port Authority is an arm’s-length federal agency responsible for the shared stewardship of the lands and waters that make up the Port of Vancouver, Canada’s largest port. Our mandate, as outlined in the Canada Marine Act, is to enable Canada’s trade objectives on behalf of all Canadians, ensuring the safe movement of goods through the Port of Vancouver while protecting the environment and considering local communities.

As an organization with a significant impact on communities and businesses across Canada, the Vancouver Fraser Port Authority is dedicated to diversity, inclusion, and sustainability. We strive to create a workplace that mirrors the richness of our community, empowering all employees to achieve their full potential.

The Portfolio Analyst supports effective management of the VFPA project portfolio by maintaining, optimizing, and analyzing the Project Portfolio Management (PPM) systems and toolkits. This role ensures data quality, upholds portfolio metadata standards, develops dashboards, and enables consistent, reliable portfolio reporting and visibility across the organization.

Working closely with project leads, PMO team members, and at times under the direction of the Senior Portfolio Advisor, the Portfolio Analyst supports portfolio monitoring, reporting, and PPM system and toolkit improvements. The role provides early warning signals and strengthens the integrity of information used in portfolio decision-making by collecting, validating, and maintaining portfolio data and reporting outputs. This role supports the enabling of efficient and scalable portfolio management practices across the VFPA.

What You Do


Provide PPM systems and toolkits expertise by offering guidance and tooling support related to portfolio reporting, controls, and standard templates; identify knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to ensure PPM systems and toolkits remain accessible, current, and fit for purpose.
Maintain portfolio metadata standards to ensure consistency and integrity across the PPM system.
Improve the efficiency and quality of portfolio reporting and system support by leveraging process automation, dashboards, AI tools, and other technology-enabled methods.
Monitor portfolio data and indicators for projects within the VFPA project portfolio and prepare regular assessments of data quality, key project performance indicators, and qualitative factors.
Establish and maintain portfolio data quality standards and controls (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), track exceptions, coordinate remediation, and escalate material or recurring issues as required.
Analyze project and portfolio data to identify trends, exceptions, and emerging risks, and provide early warning signals to support portfolio review forums and decision support.
Liaise with portfolio stakeholders – including internal teams and, where applicable, external delivery partners – to collect, validate, and reconcile portfolio data in support of portfolio reporting needs. Prepare and maintain portfolio status updates, dashboards, and reporting materials to support portfolio review forums and decision making.
Identify and escalate data anomalies, material risks, and gaps in reporting to the Manager, Project Portfolio Management and Senior Portfolio Advisor for timely action.
Demonstrate and promote the effective use of PPM processes and tools. Produce materials and guidance to support adoption and knowledge transfer.
Identify planning and scheduling interdependencies and conflicts within the VFPA project portfolio.
Support the identification and integration of lessons learned and improvement opportunities arising from pre-project and post-project reviews led by project leads.
Contribute analytical, technical, and systems expertise to department innovations and improvements, supporting the PMO leadership team in enhancing PMO processes, tools, standards, and capabilities.
Perform other assigned duties as required.



What You Bring


Completion of a two-year full-time diploma in data analytics, data engineering, management information systems, business administration, supply chain management, or another acceptable field.
Minimum three (3) years of experience in data analytics, portfolio reporting or business systems administration with at least one (1) year of experience in project management.
Experience configuring or administering Smartsheet, Smartsheet Control Center, SharePoint, or workflow/automation platforms and experience demonstrating the use of these tools to others.
Completion of a relevant foundational project or program management designation (e.g. CAPM) is an asset.
Strong technical aptitude with the ability to learn, configure, and optimize business systems, including PPM tools, workflow platforms, and reporting dashboards.
Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, assess data quality, and develop meaningful insights.
Strong understanding of project management concepts, terminology, and lifecycle processes, with the ability to apply this knowledge to portfolio monitoring and reporting.
Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with project leads, technical teams, and PMO colleagues to clarify information and resolve issues.
Effective organizational and time management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.



What We Offer


Market-competitive base salaries and variable incentive plan
Flexible remote work program
Earned time off program
Paid vacation and personal care leave
Learning, development, and advancement opportunities
Onsite gym with towel service in a national landmark in the heart of Vancouver’s waterfront
Friendly, unique, and respectful workplace
Generous and inclusive benefits offering including retirement benefits plan



Location: Vancouver, Canada

Job type: Bargaining Unit, Full-Time, Permanent, Hybrid

Working environment: Normal office conditions. Flexibility to respond to issues during non-working hours as required.

MARINE TRANSPORTATION SECURITY CLEARANCE

The incumbent must obtain and maintain a valid Marine Transportation Security Clearance as this position is required to access restricted areas/information as defined by the Marine Transportation Security Regulations.

This is Canadian-based employment, and all employees are expected to maintain legal eligibility to work in Canada. Applicants advancing in the hiring process may be subject to technical assignments, psychometric assessments, and/or background checks, including but not limited to criminal record, credit, and/or reference checks.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates including women, persons with disabilities, Indigenous peoples, and members of visible minorities. Reasonable accommodation can be provided in the selection process and while working with the port authority. If you require assistance with applying to our openings or are seeking accommodations to apply in an alternative format, please contact us at careers@portvancouver.com. We are committed to supporting your needs and will do our best to provide the necessary assistance.

Title: Jr. Data Analyst - ACX Corporate Support Edmonton
Description:
Join the ride!

Position : Jr. Data Analyst

Collision Centre: ACX Corporate Support Edmonton

Location: Edmonton, Alberta

Classification: Full-time, Immediate hire

Part of a bigger team!

ACX Corporate Support Edmonton is proud to be part of the AutoCanada Collision Centres’ network and a division of AutoCanada. AutoCanada is the largest Canadian owned and publicly traded automotive dealer group operating in Canada and the US. We are innovative, data-driven and our commitment to our Team Members, customers and operational excellence fuels our success. 

Our Team Members are at the heart of our success, building long-lasting, trust-based relationships with customers across Canada. Our national network provides opportunities and support to build the career that’s right for you. Working here is fast-paced, non-stop, and a little unpredictable—and we love it. 

Your area of focus.

You'll join the ACX (Collision Centre & Hail) Analytics & Innovation team at AutoCanada in an entry-level role focused on keeping our reporting suite running and helping migrate it from Tableau to Power BI. You'll grow into designing new dashboards, running data validation, and supporting stakeholders across our national collision repair network. Reporting into the Analytics & Innovation Lead, you'll get hands-on mentorship, direct exposure to shop managers, regional directors and senior leadership, and visibility into our AI and innovation work as your skills develop.

What drives your day-to-day?


Maintain and monitor the existing Tableau dashboard suite, ensuring reports run accurately and on schedule during the migration period.
Perform routine data validation across dashboards and reports, investigating discrepancies and partnering with Data Engineering when source data needs to be corrected.
Produce recurring monthly reports and one-off ad hoc reports for shop managers, regional directors and corporate stakeholders.
Manage the ACX user list across Tableau and Power BI, provisioning access and keeping permissions aligned with role.
Help rebuild ACX dashboards in Power BI — recreating calculations in DAX and validating that new versions match the originals.
As your Power BI skills develop, grow into designing new dashboards from scratch, contributing to dashboard digests, and helping train managers on how to use them.
Document your work so the rest of the team can pick it up.


What Are The Must-haves…


Post-secondary education in Operations Management, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Computer Science, ora related field — recent graduate's welcome.
Some hands-on experience with SQL or another programming language (coursework, co-op, internship or personal projects all count).
Working proficiency in Excel — formulas, pivot tables, and comfort cleaning up messy data.
An eye for visual design and a genuine interest in making data clear and engaging.
Self-starter mindset with the willingness to try something before asking for help, balanced with the self-awareness to ask good questions when you are genuinely stuck.
Strong written and verbal communication skills — comfortable talking with shop managers and regional leaders, not just other analysts.
Any prior exposure to Power BI (including DAX), Tableau, or another BI/dashboarding tool is a major plus. Power BI coursework, certifications (PL-300), or personal projects stand out given our current migration. 


The Perks.


Competitive Compensation and Benefits Package
Employee Vehicle Purchase & Service Plans
Employee and Family Assistance Programs
Company-wide appreciation events and contests throughout the calendar year

Title: Research & Enrolment Analyst
Description:
Job Description

This competition is open to all applicants however; internal candidates and applicants who were former employees of the University of Alberta will be given priority consideration before external candidates. Please log in to verify your internal candidate status.

There is also a 12-month temporary Research & Enrolment Analyst opportunity available. If you would like to be considered for both opportunities, please submit an application to both competitions.

Location - This role is hybrid with a mix of remote and in-person. Work primarily takes place at North Campus, Edmonton.

Reporting to the Assistant Registrar, Enrolment Research, Analytics and Insights, the Research & Enrolment Analyst plays an integral role by providing critical analysis and interpretation of enrolment data for strategic and tactical planning within the Office of the Registrar (RO) at the University of Alberta.


Generate, collect, analyze, and report data for enrolment projection/forecasting.
Conduct research to provide insight for strategic and tactical planning. This will often involve data sources both within and external to the university involving Advancement Services, Dean of Students, government agencies such as Apply Alberta, or other educational institutions.
Monitor the effect of initiatives and statistical results on Enrolment Services and Enrolment Management and provide analysis of the success of the initiatives on our student population.
Take the lead in identifying issues and providing direction with respect to the building and sharing of complex operational data reporting, provision of answers, and methods to obtain answers about the University of Alberta Student population to the Office of the Registrar Executive, and also make information available to Faculties, Departments and Administrative Units.
Respond to inquiries with evidence-based analyses to provide answers to questions from the Faculties, Departments, Administrative Units, University and Registrar Executive. When initiating new reports or agreements with university executives or external parties, negotiations are undertaken in collaboration with the Registrar or the Registrar’s executive team.
Keep relevant analyses up-to-date for immediate reference by the University and Office of the Registrar senior executive officers, planning and presentation units, and external partners.


Responsibilities


Take lead responsibility for analyzing trends in the following broad fields: Enrolment Services and Enrolment Management, including Local, National, and International students, as well as specific student populations such as Indigenous students.
Take a lead role in the Office of the Registrar's production of Business Intelligence.
In collaboration with the Assistant Registrar, Enrolment Research, Analytics, and Insights, develop, revise, monitor, and evaluate the enrolment reporting needs of the Office of the Registrar.
In collaboration with the Enrolment Management Service Partners and faculties, deliver necessary statistical and trend enrolment analyses to support planning; common areas of focus include demand estimates, admission criteria, recruitment priorities, and comparisons of student performance.
Conduct research analysis for the relevant data from existing sources or through new surveys, often in consultation with other internal offices such as the Enrolment Management Service Partners, portfolio teams under Deputy Provost Student and Enrolment, and faculties.
Develop innovative research projects to inform strategic planning and promote a culture of evidence-informed decision-making.
Develop necessary visualization tools to reflect enrolment trends and support enrolment management.
Collaborate with campus partners to ensure the relevance, consistency, and accuracy of data products and relevant behind-the-scenes logics, which involves discussions of methodologies and conducting the User Assessment Tests (UAT).
Carry out the necessary analytics, especially statistical, but also qualitative where appropriate, to explore and highlight nuances in key issues to provide answers to questions or develop positions.
Refine the analysis and information as determined in consultation with the requesting office or department.
Develop and maintain enrolment projections to ensure business leads within the Office of the Registrar and the Campus Community have relevant input for planning.
Prepare effective presentations of key research and analysis to be delivered either in person or electronically.
In response to requests that emerge from senior executives or management, consult as necessary to identify the particular questions that require analysis.
Work with communications and marketing to develop the annual enrolment report for internal and external audiences.
Conduct research and retain comparators from other institutions to facilitate comparing our business processes and performance metrics to best practices from other institutions.
Review resulting data compilations and reports to identify insights of significance to the University as well as any questions of validity and reliability.
Conduct consultations to gather insight on the needs of the RO and University community and ensure that the studies and reports published meet those needs.
Engage RO staff in understanding the value contained within the University’s data.
Keeps current on the methods and tools available within and external to our Enrolment Management and Reporting systems and recommends appropriate approaches and tools.


Qualifications


Related undergraduate degree in Social Sciences, Economics, Statistics, or related disciplines with excellent knowledge of statistical research and analytical methods and related software /technology.
Three years of experience conducting research and analysis (from information searches and selection through statistical compilation and analysis) that provides answers to critical questions within strategic time limits.
Expertise in both qualitative and quantitative aspects, preferably in a post-secondary environment.
Continuous upgrading of computer software (e.g., SAS, R, Python, Tableau, Excel), statistical and social scientific analytical skills as techniques and technology evolve.
Superior ability to work cooperatively with colleagues and with data specialists in other units and provide leadership in information gathering, trend analysis and predictive analysis.
Strong ability to analyze data, suggest recommendations, and present results to senior management.
Excellent written and oral communication skills for consultations and reports.
Excellent time management in balancing demands in a way that will ensure access to critical data, reports, or analysis within strategic time limits, including accurate preliminary estimates of project time expectations.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary

Covenir is a BPO partner to insurance carriers — and increasingly, a technology company that happens to serve them. The Platform is how that shows up day to day: modules spanning Print, Call Center, Virtual Mailroom, and Premium & Lockbox, built with an AI-assisted, 80/20 development model where AI handles the first draft and people handle the judgment. The Data Analyst owns the data and reporting that support Covenir’s business — building and maintaining the analytics that give Operations, Sales & Marketing, and leadership a single, trustworthy view of performance, while scouting the AI tools and partnerships that inform Covenir’s build-versus-partner decisions. The Platform is this role’s current top priority, but scope extends to Covenir’s broader data and reporting needs as priorities shift.

Job Description

How Covenir’s Values Show Up in This Role


Committed to WOW our Customers: The dashboards and numbers you produce are what leadership uses to make real calls — you make sure they’re right, not just plausible.
Great Just Isn’t Good Enough: You don’t stop at a working report. You ask if the metric is actually the right one, and if there’s a cleaner way to show it.
One Team, One Goal: Operations, Sales & Marketing, and IT/R&D all come to you with different questions — you treat all of them as your team, not just IT.
Passion for Excellence: Your analysis is clean enough that someone unfamiliar with the data could follow your logic without a walkthrough.


What You’ll Do


Write SQL for data extraction, transformation, and reporting across Covenir’s systems
Build and maintain executive-facing analytics and KPI dashboards — volumes, postage, and SLA performance by customer and business unit
Use Azure data services (Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Blob Storage) supporting the platform’s data warehouse
Research and evaluate AI tools, vendors, and partnership opportunities (for example, document-intelligence platforms) to inform build-versus-partner recommendations
Translate operational and business questions from Operations, Sales & Marketing, and leadership into data requests and reporting
Apply AI-assisted analysis and workflow tools, consistent with Covenir’s 80/20 model
Support data retention, security, and SOC compliance requirements as they apply to platform data


Requirements


2+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence, with proficient SQL skills
Working knowledge of Azure data services (Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Blob Storage) or equivalent cloud data tools; AWS experience a plus
Fundamental knowledge of insurance BPO business processes across Print, Call Center, Virtual Mailroom, and Premium & Lockbox
Working knowledge of data collection across multiple business functions, and of data retention and access-control policies
Basic understanding of the AI/API sandbox and its available data workflows
Experience building executive-facing dashboards or KPI reporting
Comfortable researching and evaluating vendors, tools, or partnership opportunities
Ability to create clear, concise data analysis and reporting documentation for stakeholders across Operations, Sales & Marketing, and IT & R&D
Completes data security and confidentiality training, SOC compliance training, and cross-functional onboarding across Platform modules
Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business), or equivalent experience
Performs other duties as assigned by the R&D Manager in support of Covenir’s broader business needs


What An A Player Looks Like


Numbers you can defend. A players can explain exactly how a metric was calculated and why it’s the right one, not just hand over a dashboard.
Translates business questions into data. When Sales & Marketing or Operations asks a vague question, A players know how to turn it into the right query.
Curious about AI tooling. A players actively track what’s out there, not just when asked to evaluate a specific vendor.
Comfortable being the single source of truth. When numbers conflict across teams, A players are the ones who resolve which version is right.
Documents the logic, not just the output. A players leave behind reporting anyone can pick up, not a black box only they understand.


Is This Role For You?

Strong fit


Proficient in SQL and comfortable owning data
extraction, transformation, and reporting end to end
Enjoys translating vague business questions into
concrete data requests
Genuinely curious about AI tools and vendor
landscapes, not just the data itself
Comfortable being the tie-breaker when numbers
across teams don’t match


Skip this role if


You want a narrowly scoped reporting role with no ambiguity
You’re not interested in researching AI tools or vendors
You’d rather avoid being the one who resolves conflicting numbers
You need requests to come from a single, consistent source

Regular

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Vencora Business Unit

VBU - Covenir

Job Summary

Covenir is a BPO partner to insurance carriers — and increasingly, a technology company that happens to serve them. The Platform is how that shows up day to day: modules spanning Print, Call Center, Virtual Mailroom, and Premium & Lockbox, built with an AI-assisted, 80/20 development model where AI handles the first draft and people handle the judgment. The Data Analyst owns the data and reporting that support Covenir’s business — building and maintaining the analytics that give Operations, Sales & Marketing, and leadership a single, trustworthy view of performance, while scouting the AI tools and partnerships that inform Covenir’s build-versus-partner decisions. The Platform is this role’s current top priority, but scope extends to Covenir’s broader data and reporting needs as priorities shift.

Job Description

How Covenir’s Values Show Up in This Role


Committed to WOW our Customers: The dashboards and numbers you produce are what leadership uses to make real calls — you make sure they’re right, not just plausible.
Great Just Isn’t Good Enough: You don’t stop at a working report. You ask if the metric is actually the right one, and if there’s a cleaner way to show it.
One Team, One Goal: Operations, Sales & Marketing, and IT/R&D all come to you with different questions — you treat all of them as your team, not just IT.
Passion for Excellence: Your analysis is clean enough that someone unfamiliar with the data could follow your logic without a walkthrough.


What You’ll Do


Write SQL for data extraction, transformation, and reporting across Covenir’s systems
Build and maintain executive-facing analytics and KPI dashboards — volumes, postage, and SLA performance by customer and business unit
Use Azure data services (Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Blob Storage) supporting the platform’s data warehouse
Research and evaluate AI tools, vendors, and partnership opportunities (for example, document-intelligence platforms) to inform build-versus-partner recommendations
Translate operational and business questions from Operations, Sales & Marketing, and leadership into data requests and reporting
Apply AI-assisted analysis and workflow tools, consistent with Covenir’s 80/20 model
Support data retention, security, and SOC compliance requirements as they apply to platform data


Requirements


2+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence, with proficient SQL skills
Working knowledge of Azure data services (Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Blob Storage) or equivalent cloud data tools; AWS experience a plus
Fundamental knowledge of insurance BPO business processes across Print, Call Center, Virtual Mailroom, and Premium & Lockbox
Working knowledge of data collection across multiple business functions, and of data retention and access-control policies
Basic understanding of the AI/API sandbox and its available data workflows
Experience building executive-facing dashboards or KPI reporting
Comfortable researching and evaluating vendors, tools, or partnership opportunities
Ability to create clear, concise data analysis and reporting documentation for stakeholders across Operations, Sales & Marketing, and IT & R&D
Completes data security and confidentiality training, SOC compliance training, and cross-functional onboarding across Platform modules
Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business), or equivalent experience
Performs other duties as assigned by the R&D Manager in support of Covenir’s broader business needs


What An A Player Looks Like


Numbers you can defend. A players can explain exactly how a metric was calculated and why it’s the right one, not just hand over a dashboard.
Translates business questions into data. When Sales & Marketing or Operations asks a vague question, A players know how to turn it into the right query.
Curious about AI tooling. A players actively track what’s out there, not just when asked to evaluate a specific vendor.
Comfortable being the single source of truth. When numbers conflict across teams, A players are the ones who resolve which version is right.
Documents the logic, not just the output. A players leave behind reporting anyone can pick up, not a black box only they understand.


Is This Role For You?

Strong fit


Proficient in SQL and comfortable owning data
extraction, transformation, and reporting end to end
Enjoys translating vague business questions into
concrete data requests
Genuinely curious about AI tools and vendor
landscapes, not just the data itself
Comfortable being the tie-breaker when numbers
across teams don’t match


Skip this role if


You want a narrowly scoped reporting role with no ambiguity
You’re not interested in researching AI tools or vendors
You’d rather avoid being the one who resolves conflicting numbers
You need requests to come from a single, consistent source

Regular

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
About Purple Carrot

Founded in 2014, Purple Carrot delivers clean, long-lasting energy through the power of plants. As the only company in America devoted entirely to plant-based eating, we have spent over a decade perfecting the balance of protein and fiber that only plants can provide. Offering chef-crafted, dietitian-designed meals delivered right to your door, we make plant-forward eating effortless, flexible, and endlessly exciting. Our menu spans quick weeknight dishes, occasion-worthy dinners, breakfast, lunch, snacks, and ready-to-eat meals.

Purple Carrot prioritizes taste and flexibility, offering no membership fees, the freedom to skip or unskip weekly deliveries whenever you want, and a no-pressure, cancel-anytime policy. We pride ourselves on doing plants better than anyone else - and we have the receipts to prove it.

Description

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our mission-driven team. As an integral part of the Data team, you will join forces with the Senior Analytics Engineer in our continued effort to inspire people to eat more plants.

This position will play an important role in building and maintaining resilient, scalable data pipelines and company-wide data infrastructure that empowers Purple Carrot employees to better understand, manage, curate, and analyze the data most relevant to their work.

As the Analytics Engineer, you will be focused on maintaining and improving our data pipelines, supporting data systems and analytics, and helping develop rigorous data products within our modern data stack. This role will synthesize feedback from teams across the business and help translate data needs into reliable, well-documented solutions that allow us to move faster and gain better insights into how our business performs.

We greatly thank all applicants; however, only those under serious consideration will be contacted.

Location


This hybrid role is based in Dedham, MA
Our hybrid approach includes 3 days in-office each week, giving teams the best of both flexibility and collaboration. Many team members choose to come in more often - it's a great way to stay inspired and engaged with the team



On the Plate


Lead and contribute to the implementation and maintenance of end-to-end data pipelines and infrastructure, from ingestion through transformation and analytics
Develop, test, and optimize data models and data warehouse architecture with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability
Ensure data quality through validation, monitoring, testing, and strong documentation practices
Implement and uphold data governance standards, including data dictionaries, lineage, access controls, and clear ownership of business logic
Build and maintain BI dashboards and reporting tools that help teams understand performance and make data-informed decisions
Support occasional ad hoc and exploratory data analysis to help answer business questions and identify trends
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for data models, pipelines, reporting logic, and key data definitions
Collaborate closely with the Senior Analytics Engineer and cross-functional partners to execute on defined workstreams within an established data framework
Assist with ad-hoc projects and tasks as necessary



Main Ingredients for the Role


2-3 years of experience in the data space as a senior data analyst, data analyst, analytics engineer, data engineer, or equivalent role
Bachelor's degree in data analytics, computer science, information systems, business analytics, mathematics, statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience
Able to commute to the Dedham, MA office 3 days per week
Proficiency in SQL and dbt for data transformation, automation, and modeling
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines using modern data stack technologies such as Git, dbt, Stitch, cloud data warehouses, or similar tools
Strong background in data quality assurance, governance frameworks, and best practices for documentation
Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Looker, Omni, or similar platforms
Ability to work independently on assigned workstreams while collaborating closely with a senior team member
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment



Extra Special Sauce


Experience working in or supporting a B2C subscription business model
Comfortable working within an established data framework while driving execution independently on defined workstreams
Strong curiosity and ability to translate business questions into clear, scalable data solutions
Excitement for working in a dynamic environment where data helps teams make faster, smarter decisions
You enjoy documentation, process improvement, and building systems that make work easier for others



Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $90,000 - $100,00. Compensation is based on experience and qualifications, and the posted range is not a guarantee of any specific offer.

Garnish

We love our staff, and show it with benefits (including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, FSA, and life insurance), matching retirement plan, generous and flexible paid time off, Purple Carrot box delivery credits, professional development, and the opportunity to work in collaboration with teammates who are passionate about food!

Final Touches

We are committed to a safe and inclusive work environment, free of discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetics, national origin, ancestry, age, medical condition, mental or physical disability, handicap, veteran status, or marital status.
